say:0:1222601001:0.female: Sonja has been looking for you. She's waiting at the Whispers Office.

say:5:1222602003:1.female: Woah! Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>?! Sorry, madam, we didn't see you there! Please don't mind our ramblings...

say:6:1222602004:1.source_cn: 不不不，问题可大了，魔法师大人！我告诉您，一个搞不好，...

say:6:1222602004:1.female: Wait, Anders! This is serious, I think we should tell her. If we're not careful, the <style="highlight">Dead Tide Fleet might rise again</style>!

B-boss! This is a serious matter, please hear us out!

say:10:1222602006:1.source_cn: 二、二当家！我没胡说！\n老戴夫说他亲眼看见<styl...

say:11:1222602007:1.text: The Dead Tide Fleet might come ashore as soon as tomorrow!
say:11:1222602007:1.source_cn: 死潮舰队说不定明天就会上岸啦！

say:13:1222602008:1.text: But we already defeated them, and they sank to the ocean floor!
say:13:1222602008:1.source_cn: 但是，死潮舰队已经被我们击溃，沉入海底了！

say:17:1222602010:1.text: Anyways, even if there are a few Dead Tide stragglers out there, our mighty Magister will take care of them!
say:17:1222602010:1.source_cn: 就算没看错，几条漏网之鱼也没什么可怕，毕竟有主人在呢。
say:17:1222602010:1.male: Anyways, even if there are a few Dead Tide stragglers out there, our mighty Magister will take care of them!
say:17:1222602010:1.female: Anyways, even if there are a few Dead Tide stragglers out there, our mighty Magister will take care of them!

say:18:1222602011:1.text: Is this what Sonja called us here to discuss?
say:18:1222602011:1.source_cn: 难道索尼娅找我们来，就是为了商量这个？

say:21:1222602012:1.text: The Graveborn sighting is still just a rumor. I'll speak to the witness for more details.
say:21:1222602012:1.source_cn: 亡灵再次出没只是个传言，还没有确凿证据。那个目击者我认...

say:22:1222602013:1.text: If it really is a Dead Tide survivor, we'll track her down.
say:22:1222602013:1.source_cn: 一个亡灵而已，我们会找出她。

say:23:1222602014:1.text: Sonja actually has more urgent matters to discuss with you. She's waiting for you at the Whispers office.
say:23:1222602014:1.source_cn: 索尼娅想找你们谈的事情更为紧急，你们还是当面聊比较好，...

say:24:1222602015:1.text: Oh, and one more thing, Ashby, Anders.

say:25:1222602016:1.source_cn: 是、是！二当家，有什么吩咐？

say:26:1222602017:0.text: Watch your mouths. The Carmine Whispers doesn't take kindly to gossiping cowards!
say:26:1222602017:0.source_cn: ——管好自己的嘴巴。血薇帮容不下嚼舌根的胆小鬼！

say:3:1222603001:0.text: Let me get straight to the point. I asked you here to talk about the <style="highlight">Bantus Void Relic</style>.
say:3:1222603001:0.source_cn: 直说正题吧，我请你们来，是关于<style=highl...

say:4:1222603002:1.text: You remember Hodgkin using it to control Nara and the sea monster, yes?
say:4:1222603002:1.source_cn: 你们应该记得，霍德希金用那东西控制过奈拉和海怪。

say:5:1222603003:1.text: It should have gone down with Hodgkin and the Immortal. Did you find it?
say:5:1222603003:1.source_cn: 最后决战时，它应该跟着霍德希金和不死号一起沉入海里了，...

say:6:1222603004:1.text: I've had people searching the area, but there's no progress so far.
say:6:1222603004:1.source_cn: 这段时间我一直在派人打捞，很遗憾，仍然没有半点进展。

say:7:1222603005:1.text: You may have heard the rumors earlier. There's talk of a Graveborn woman near the docks. I suspect...
say:7:1222603005:1.source_cn: 刚才你们在门外也听到了，有传言称，在码头见到了女性亡灵...

choice_prompt:8:1222603005.text: You may have heard the rumors earlier. There's talk of a Graveborn woman near the docks. I suspect...
choice_prompt:8:1222603005.source_cn: 刚才你们在门外也听到了，有传言称，在码头见到了女性亡灵。我怀疑她可能是——

say:9:1222603006:1.text: Part of me hopes it's her. But it's more likely someone else.
say:9:1222603006:1.source_cn: 或许我的确有一些私心，希望那是奈拉。但我认为，她是另一...

say:10:1222603007:1.text: I actually believe it's Bonnie, the one who escaped after we defeated her. She's been missing since then.
say:10:1222603007:1.source_cn: 被我们打败后，逃走的波妮一直下落不明，我怀疑是她。

say:11:1222603010:1.text: Beyond that, I also suspect the Void Relic may no longer be <style="highlight">in the sea</style>.
say:11:1222603010:1.source_cn: 除此之外，我猜测，班题斯圣器可能已经<style=hi...

say:12:1222603011:1.text: Are you saying Bonnie already found the sunken Void Relic?
say:12:1222603011:1.source_cn: 你的意思是，波妮说不定已经用什么办法，找到了坠入海中的...

say:13:1222603012:1.text: She was Hodgkin's trusted first mate. It is possible.
say:13:1222603012:1.source_cn: 她是霍德希金信任的大副，不是没有这种可能。

say:14:1222603013:1.text: Of course, this is just speculation for now. I'll continue the search, but I'll also need your help.
say:14:1222603013:1.source_cn: 当然，这都只是推测。总之，我还会继续派人打捞。

say:15:1222603014:1.text: Please keep an ear out for any clues about the relic or similar rumors.
say:15:1222603014:1.source_cn: 但也要麻烦你们多多留意，例如，是否能察觉到班题斯圣器的...

choice_prompt:16:1222603014.text: Please keep an ear out for any clues about the relic or similar rumors.
choice_prompt:16:1222603014.source_cn: 但也要麻烦你们多多留意，例如，是否能察觉到班题斯圣器的魔力，或是听到了类似的传言。

say:17:1222603015:1.text: And as for the witness... Lucca, I have other matters to attend to. Could you fill them in on the details?
say:17:1222603015:1.source_cn: 至于那位目击者……卢卡，我还有其他事，你来说明详细情况吧。

say:21:1222603017:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Lucca will give you more information. The Whispers greatly appreciate your help.
say:21:1222603017:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Lucca will give you more information. The Whispers greatly appreciate your help.
say:21:1222603017:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Lucca will give you more information. The Whispers greatly appreciate your help.

say:23:1222603008:1.text: Yes. The last time we saw her was on the Immortal, but no one saw where she went in the chaos.
say:23:1222603008:1.source_cn: 没错。我们最后再见是在不死号上，但在混战中，没人注意她...

say:24:1222603009:1.text: In other words, her whereabouts are unknown.

say:2:1222604001:1.text: Someone spotted a Graveborn at the docks, and it's causing a big stir.
say:2:1222604001:1.source_cn: 有人在码头看见了亡灵，这消息传开后引发了很大的骚动。

say:3:1222604002:1.text: The unlucky witness is a fisherman named Dave. He's lived in Rustport for decades.
say:3:1222604002:1.source_cn: 那个倒霉的目击者叫老戴夫，是个渔民，在锈锚港生活了好几十年。

say:4:1222604003:1.text: I've dealt with him before. Though he may be old and grumpy, he seemed like an honest man. Not one to spread rumors or cause trouble...
say:4:1222604003:1.source_cn: 我以前跟他打过交道。他虽然性子暴躁，但正直本分，不是那...

say:5:1222604004:1.text: Alright, then it seems unlikely he's lying. Can we ask him directly?
say:5:1222604004:1.source_cn: 按你说的，这位老戴夫应该没撒谎，我们能否和他直接聊聊呢？

say:6:1222604005:1.text: Perhaps it was a misunderstanding. What if what he saw wasn't a Graveborn, but just someone who hasn't seen the sun in a while?
say:6:1222604005:1.source_cn: 说不定只是一场误会，也许他看到的并不是亡灵，而是某种魔物。

say:7:1222604006:1.text: Hmm. I've already arranged to meet him at the inn. It's about time, so let's go.
say:7:1222604006:1.source_cn: 嗯。我跟他约好了在旅店碰头，时间差不多了，我们这就去找他吧。

say:0:1222605001:0.text: Let's head over quickly, Old Dave's always been impatient.
say:0:1222605001:0.source_cn: 去旅店吧，老戴夫是个急性子。

say:0:1222606001:0.text: There's tons of people here so we agreed to meet on the second floor.
say:0:1222606001:0.source_cn: 楼下人多口杂，我们约在二楼见面。

say:1:1222607002:0.text: I'm tellin' the truth, ye fool!
say:1:1222607002:0.source_cn: 我说的是实话！你这蠢货！

say:2:1222608001:0.text: Old Dave, it's all your fault! Everywhere I go, people are saying the Graveborn are back, that the Dead Tide Fleet is coming again!
say:2:1222608001:0.source_cn: 老戴夫！我走到哪都能听见别人说亡灵又来了，死潮舰队又要来了！

say:3:1222608002:0.text: Seriously, are you trying to ruin the peace that Rustport fought so hard to gain?!
say:3:1222608002:0.source_cn: 你想毁了锈锚港好不容易才得到的安宁？

say:4:1222608003:0.text: I never said nothin' 'bout the Dead Tide Fleet!
say:4:1222608003:0.source_cn: 我可从来没提过什么死潮舰队！

say:5:1222608004:0.text: But I did see a Graveborn woman! It's a fact!
say:5:1222608004:0.source_cn: 但我真的看见了女亡灵！那不是造谣，是事实！

say:6:1222608005:0.text: You're getting old, man. You're confusing your dreams with reality. I dreamt the Dead Tide Fleet came to this tavern last night and danced to sea shanties, but that was just a dream!
say:6:1222608005:0.source_cn: 别发癔症，你把自己做的梦当真了。我昨晚还梦见死潮舰队走...

say:7:1222608006:1.text: Better hope ye stay in dreamland, 'cause in reality, ye'd be the first one runnin' out the door, screamin' like a seagull with its tail on fire.
say:7:1222608006:1.source_cn: 怎么着，睁开眼你发现自己尿了一床吗？

say:8:1222608007:1.text: Damn it! I'll tear that fishy-smelling mouth of yours apart!
say:8:1222608007:1.source_cn: 该死！我非得撕烂你这张鱼腥味的臭嘴！

say:11:1222608009:1.text: Second-in-command? You came just in time, this guy—
say:11:1222608009:1.source_cn: 二当家？你来得正好，这家伙他——

say:12:1222608010:1.text: Bols, leave this to me. Go tend to your customers.
say:12:1222608010:1.source_cn: 波尔斯，这里交给我，去招呼你的客人们吧。

say:16:1222608013:0.text: Cool down, Dave. I know you wouldn't lie about something like this.
say:16:1222608013:0.source_cn: 冷静点。老戴夫，我知道你不会为这种事撒谎。

say:17:1222608014:1.text: Tell me what exactly happened that night, I want all the details of your mysterious encounter.
say:17:1222608014:1.source_cn: 我相信你看见了诡异的东西，详细讲讲那天晚上的遭遇吧。

say:18:1222608015:1.text: Hmph, ye make it sound so romantic, eh? Mysterious encounter me arse! It was a Graveborn, I swear it!
say:18:1222608015:1.source_cn: 连你也学会语言的艺术了啊？那可不是什么诡异的东西，那是亡灵！

say:19:1222608016:1.text: That night, I'd jus' hauled in me nets and was back at the docks. I was tyin' up me boat and there she was, standin' on the pier.
say:19:1222608016:1.source_cn: 那天晚上，我收了网回到码头，正在栓船，突然看到码头上有...

say:20:1222608017:1.text: I could tell it was a woman, and aye, a beauty she was at first glance. But then... I saw her face.
say:20:1222608017:1.source_cn: 我知道那是个女人，哼，一看就知道是个漂亮妞。要不是我马...

say:21:1222608018:1.text: Her skin was pale as a dead fish, and her eyes—those glowin' green eyes!
say:21:1222608018:1.source_cn: 她的皮肤死鱼般灰白，还有两只闪着绿光的眼睛！

say:24:1222608019:1.text: Definitely sounds like a Graveborn. Were you scared?
say:24:1222608019:1.source_cn: 的确是亡灵的样貌呢，你当时吓坏了吧？

say:25:1222608020:1.text: Aye... I'll admit it, I screamed so loud, I scared away every fish within a hundred meters.
say:25:1222608020:1.source_cn: 是……真丢人啊，我惨叫一声，方圆几百码的鱼都要被我吓跑了。

say:26:1222608021:1.text: She noticed me, all right, but didn't strike me down. Nah, she just turned and leapt into the night, vanishin' without a trace...
say:26:1222608021:1.source_cn: 那亡灵注意到我，但她竟然没要我的命，而是转身跳进夜色里...

say:27:1222608022:1.text: I swear by the god o' the waves, if I'm lyin', let the sea swallow me whole and feed me to the sharks!
say:27:1222608022:1.source_cn: 我发誓，要有半点假话，下次我出海，立刻被浪头卷走喂鲨鱼！

say:30:1222608023:1.text: Wow, Chippy can feel the honesty radiating from this man!

say:31:1222608024:1.text: Lucca, ye understand now, don't ye?
say:31:1222608024:1.source_cn: 卢卡，这就是我看见的一切。你们应该明白我的态度了！

say:32:1222608025:1.text: I ain't never seen the Dead Tide Fleet, and I never claimed that the Graveborn was one o' them. Them rumors didn't come from me!
say:32:1222608025:1.source_cn: 我没见过死潮舰队，也没说过那亡灵是死潮的人。造谣的不是我！

say:33:1222608026:1.text: We'll get to the bottom of this.

say:34:1222608027:1.text: Dave, go home and lay low for a bit. The Whispers will keep an eye on you.
say:34:1222608027:1.source_cn: 老戴夫，你回家里避避风头吧，血薇帮会在暗中保护你。

say:35:1222608028:1.text: I can't be hidin' forever, so ye better figure this out soon!
say:35:1222608028:1.source_cn: 我可不会避一辈子的风头，你们最好早点调查清楚！

say:37:1222608029:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think there's anything noteworthy about Dave's account?

say:41:1222608030:0.text: Hmm... It's hard to say if it was Bonnie, Nara, or another Graveborn altogether.
say:41:1222608030:0.source_cn: 嗯……很难说那究竟是波妮还是奈拉，又或者是另一位美丽的亡灵。

say:42:1222608032:1.text: After thinking it over, I believe it's more likely to be Bonnie.
say:42:1222608032:1.source_cn: 我仔细想了想，还是波妮的可能性更高。

say:43:1222608033:1.text: She was the first mate of the Dead Tide Fleet, right?
say:43:1222608033:1.source_cn: 波妮？你是说死潮舰队的大副。

say:45:1222608034:1.text: Yes, perhaps she managed to escape the Immortal before it sunk back then.
say:45:1222608034:1.source_cn: 对。不死号大战时，波妮也在，也许她并没有葬身海底，而是...

say:46:1222608035:1.text: Lucca, if you were Bonnie, what would you do next?
say:46:1222608035:1.source_cn: 卢卡，假如你是波妮，你接下来会怎么做呢？

say:47:1222608036:1.text: If it were me... I'd rally any survivors, build up strength, and seek revenge for Hodgkin.
say:47:1222608036:1.source_cn: 集结幸存者，积蓄力量，为霍德希金复仇。

say:48:1222608037:1.text: Where would she go? The base at Ragebone Cove?
say:48:1222608037:1.source_cn: 她可能去哪里？兽骨滩的基地吗？

say:49:1222608038:1.text: No, we've kept constant surveillance on that place. If she's smart, she wouldn't walk into that trap.
say:49:1222608038:1.source_cn: 不，我们一直派人监督着兽骨滩。她如果聪明，不会自投罗网。

say:50:1222608039:1.text: The only place left is the research base at the bottom of Greenbrook's well. The Dead Tide Fleet used to conduct their experiments there.
say:50:1222608039:1.source_cn: 那么，就只有我们在绿水村井底发现的研究基地了。死潮舰队...

say:52:1222608041:1.text: We almost missed it the first time we went!
say:52:1222608041:1.source_cn: 我们第一次去时，差点就错过了！

say:53:1222608042:1.text: Alright, sounds like it's worth checking out.

say:58:1222608031:0.text: Then we may be able to assume that it wasn't Nara. Could it really have been Bonnie?
say:58:1222608031:0.source_cn: 她没有伤害发现自己的老戴夫，不太像奈拉的作风，难道真的...

say:3:1222609001:1.male: Why'd you stop, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Did you see something?

say:8:1222609005:1.text: How odd. Could it have been an illusion?

choice_prompt:9:1222609005.text: How odd. Could it have been an illusion?

say:10:1222609006:1.text: Just in case, I'll have Bols send more men to see if anyone else sees anything strange.
say:10:1222609006:1.source_cn: 以防万一，我让波尔斯在附近多派人手，看看有没有其他目击者。

say:11:1222609007:1.text: For now, let's keep investigating Ashen Bay.
say:11:1222609007:1.source_cn: 当下还是先去灰烬湾调查吧。

choice:9:0:1.male: I swear, that's what I saw!

choice:4:1:2.male: I think I just saw a woman...
choice:4:1:2.female: I think I just saw a woman...

say:0:1222610001:0.text: We should get to Ashen Bay.
say:0:1222610001:0.source_cn: 当务之急是去灰烬湾一探究竟。

say:0:1222611001:0.text: It's just as messy here as it was when we first passed through.
say:0:1222611001:0.source_cn: 这里和我们初次来时一样乱糟糟的。

say:1:1222611002:0.text: Wait. It looks like someone's been searching for something here...
say:1:1222611002:0.source_cn: 不，看起来有人翻找过东西，村里更凌乱了。

say:3:1222612001:1.text: It's such a mess! There's barely room to walk. Be careful, everyone.
say:3:1222612001:1.source_cn: 简直乱得下不去脚！你们小心。

say:5:1222612002:1.source_cn: 主人的身手可是很敏捷的——哇呀呀呀！

say:6:1222612003:1.text: Ouch, ouch! Why is there a drawer here?
say:6:1222612003:1.source_cn: 疼死了……这里怎么会有个抽屉？

say:7:1222612004:1.text: Everything in that cabinet was taken out, even the drawers.
say:7:1222612004:1.source_cn: 柜子里的东西全都倒在地上了，连抽屉都没放过。

say:8:1222612005:1.text: Maybe someone was searching for something and fled in a hurry.
say:8:1222612005:1.source_cn: 看着像是听到了什么风吹草动，于是翻到一半就跑了。

say:9:1222612006:1.text: That means there's a good chance they'll return. Let's stake out here, we might catch them!
say:9:1222612006:1.source_cn: 这意味着对方返回的概率很高。我们在这里蹲守，说不定会有...

say:10:1222612007:1.text: Let's do it! We'll find a good hiding spot.
say:10:1222612007:1.source_cn: 那就试试运气吧！我们找个地方埋伏起来。

say:3:1222613001:1.text: Good, this spot is well hidden and gives us a clear view.
say:3:1222613001:1.source_cn: 很好，这位置足够隐蔽，又能监视对面。

say:4:1222613002:1.text: How long should we wait? What if they don't come back?
say:4:1222613002:1.source_cn: 我们要等多久？要是那个人没回来怎么办？

choice_prompt:5:1222613002.text: How long should we wait? What if they don't come back?
choice_prompt:5:1222613002.source_cn: 我们要等多久？要是那个人没回来怎么办？

say:6:1222613003:1.text: Chippy, you gotta believe in the Magister's luck! Luck is part of skill too, you know.
say:6:1222613003:1.source_cn: 满满，你要相信梅林的运气！运气也是实力的一部分。
say:6:1222613003:1.male: Chippy, you gotta believe in the Magister's luck! Luck is part of skill too, you know.
say:6:1222613003:1.female: Chippy, you gotta believe in the Magister's luck! Luck is part of skill too, you know.

say:7:1222613005:1.text: I'm sure they'll come at <style="highlight">night</style> like the sneaky thief they are!

choice:5:0:1.text: My instincts tell me they'll come.
choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 要是没找到东西，那个人还会回来
choice:5:0:1.male: My instincts tell me they'll come.
choice:5:0:1.female: My instincts tell me they'll come.

say:9:1222613004:1.text: Oh, I see! If it's a Graveborn, they're more likely to move under the cover of darkness.
say:9:1222613004:1.source_cn: 我懂了，如果对方是亡灵，多半是趁夜行动。

say:0:1222615001:0.text: Let's follow her and see what she's after.
say:0:1222615001:0.source_cn: 跟上！看看她到底在找什么。

say:0:1222616001:0.text: This place is so well-hidden... damn Dead Tide Fleet.
say:0:1222616001:0.source_cn: 这地方的确隐蔽，该死的死潮舰队。

say:0:1222617001:0.text: These are Bonnie's footprints. She's heading to the research facility!
say:0:1222617001:0.source_cn: 这是波妮的脚印，她往研究所去了！

say:2:1222620001:0.text: I finally caught you! Now where have you been hiding? Is there anyone else here?
say:2:1222620001:0.source_cn: 终于逮到你了！你之前藏在哪？还有没有其他同党！

say:4:1222620003:0.text: We know what you're after. Now, tell us. Where did Hodgkin have you hide the Void Relic?
say:4:1222620003:0.source_cn: 我们知道你在找什么。说，霍德希金让你把班题斯圣器藏在哪里了。

say:5:1222620004:0.text: How do you—no, I don't know where the relic is.
say:5:1222620004:0.source_cn: 你们怎么……？！不，我不知道圣器在哪。

choice_prompt:6:1222620004.text: How do you—no, I don't know where the relic is.
choice_prompt:6:1222620004.source_cn: 你们怎么……？！不，我不知道圣器在哪。

say:8:1222620005:0.text: Bonnie, everyone knows the relic sank to the bottom of the sea, but it's funny you didn't mention that.
say:8:1222620005:0.source_cn: 波妮，圣器沉入海底是大家公认的事实，你却没这么说。

say:9:1222620006:0.text: So, you must know where it is now, right?
say:9:1222620006:0.source_cn: 所以，你其实知道它另有下落吧？

say:10:1222620007:0.text: Hmph... Magister, that little hamster you trained has a wild imagination.
say:10:1222620007:0.source_cn: 哼……大魔法师，你养的小老鼠还是太缺乏想象力了。
say:10:1222620007:0.male: Hmph... Magister, that little hamster you trained has a wild imagination.
say:10:1222620007:0.female: Hmph... Magister, that little hamster you trained has a wild imagination.

say:11:1222620008:0.text: Looks like you'll need a little persuasion before you start talking. Just so you know, the Carmine Whispers doesn't play nice with Graveborn!
say:11:1222620008:0.source_cn: 看来得吃点苦头才愿意开口。告诉你，血薇帮不会对亡灵手软！

say:12:1222620009:0.text: Hah! The relic only answers to its rightful master—the mighty captain of the Dead Tide Fleet, Hodgkin!
say:12:1222620009:0.source_cn: 蠢货，圣器只认可它的主人——死潮舰队的伟大船长，霍德希金！

say:13:1222620010:0.text: You think you can wield its power? Don't make me laugh.
say:13:1222620010:0.source_cn: 单凭你们也妄图号令它？不要做梦。

say:14:1222620011:0.text: The Dead Tide Fleet is nothing more than bones and barnacles, rotting beneath the waves.
say:14:1222620011:0.source_cn: 死潮舰队都已经和海底的礁石为伴了。

say:15:1222620012:0.text: And as for your precious captain? If he's still alive, he's choking on seaweed right now.
say:15:1222620012:0.source_cn: 至于你的狗屁船长，就算他死不了，估计这会儿也在忙着抠出...

say:16:1222620013:0.text: Cherish these moments where you can still speak with such reckless abandon.
say:16:1222620013:0.source_cn: 珍惜现在吧，你还能嚣张地放肆言语。

say:17:1222620014:0.text: Because when those black sails rise again on the horizon, the fear will drown you before the tide does!
say:17:1222620014:0.source_cn: 当黑帆在海面上扬起，风浪会将恐惧重新推回到你们脸上！

say:21:1222620016:0.text: Lucca, don't lose your temper. Come here, I have something to tell you.
say:21:1222620016:0.source_cn: 卢卡，你被愤怒冲昏头了，我们先找个地方慢慢商议吧。

say:24:1222620017:0.text: Mm... She's too hurt to move right now. Don't worry, Chippy will keep an eye on her!
say:24:1222620017:0.source_cn: 嗯，她受了伤，一时片刻逃不掉。满满会看住她！

narration:29:1222620019:0.text: After telling Chippy to keep a watch on her, the group moves to a spot where Bonnie can't overhear them.
narration:29:1222620019:0.source_cn: 控制住波妮后，大家走到不会被她监听的地方进行交谈——

say:31:1222620020:0.text: *Sigh* She really has a sharp tongue...
say:31:1222620020:0.source_cn: 唉，这位大副嘴真的很硬。

say:32:1222620021:0.text: No point wasting our time talking. Let's show her the power of the Carmine Whispers!
say:32:1222620021:0.source_cn: 不用和她废话。让她见识见识血薇帮的特殊手段！

say:33:1222620022:0.text: You can't solve everything with violence, Lucca! She's a Graveborn, and fiercely loyal to the Dead Tide Fleet.
say:33:1222620022:0.source_cn: 不过，亡灵的意志力很顽强，她又对死潮舰队忠心耿耿，暴力...

say:34:1222620023:0.text: Are we going to just sit here and wait for her to crack? Or...
say:34:1222620023:0.source_cn: 要在这里跟她耗着吗？还是……

choice_prompt:35:1222620023.text: Are we going to just sit here and wait for her to crack? Or...
choice_prompt:35:1222620023.source_cn: 要在这里跟她耗着吗？还是……

say:37:1222620025:1.text: Lucca, remember, our goal is the Void Relic, not revenge on the Dead Tide Fleet.
say:37:1222620025:1.source_cn: 卢卡，别忘了，我们真正的目标是找到班题斯圣器，而不是向...

say:38:1222620026:1.text: Based on Bonnie's reaction, it's obvious she knows where the relic is.
say:38:1222620026:1.source_cn: 根据波妮的反应，基本可以确定她知道圣器的位置。

say:39:1222620027:1.text: I see. You think that if she had the chance, she'd go check on it or move it to a safer place.
say:39:1222620027:1.source_cn: 如果她有机会从我们眼皮底下逃走，她多半会去确认圣器的安...

say:40:1222620028:1.text: We could perhaps let her escape on purpose and follow her.
say:40:1222620028:1.source_cn: 所以，可以故意放走波妮，然后在暗地里悄悄跟踪她。

say:41:1222620029:1.text: Though it would be a big risk...

say:42:1222620030:1.text: Even if Bonnie suspects something, I think she'll still take the risk if it means protecting the relic.
say:42:1222620030:1.source_cn: 就算波妮也猜到了我们的计谋，只要是为了保护班题斯圣器，...

say:43:1222620031:1.text: ... It's worth a try. What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:43:1222620031:1.male: ... It's worth a try. What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
say:43:1222620031:1.female: ... It's worth a try. What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

choice_prompt:44:1222620031.text: ... It's worth a try. What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
choice_prompt:44:1222620031.male: ... It's worth a try. What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?
choice_prompt:44:1222620031.female: ... It's worth a try. What do you think, <style="stress"><player_name></style>?

say:46:1222620034:1.text: Then it's settled. We'll put on a show for Bonnie.
say:46:1222620034:1.source_cn: 那就这么定了，我们也演一出戏给波妮看。
say:46:1222620034:1.male: Then it's settled. We'll put on a show for Bonnie.
say:46:1222620034:1.female: Then it's settled. We'll put on a show for Bonnie.

narration:52:1222620036:0.text: You head back to see Chippy pointing his sword at Bonnie with a serious expression.
narration:52:1222620036:0.source_cn: 重新回到原来的地方，满满正严肃地拿剑指着波妮

say:53:1222620037:0.text: You're back! She seems to have given up on running away!
say:53:1222620037:0.source_cn: 主人，你们回来了！她没有逃跑的迹象！
say:53:1222620037:0.male: You're back! She seems to have given up on running away!
say:53:1222620037:0.female: You're back! She seems to have given up on running away!

say:54:1222620038:0.text: Good job. I'll tie her up now so she can't escape.

say:55:1222620039:0.text: Don't touch me with your dirty hands! Lout!
say:55:1222620039:0.source_cn: 别用你的脏手碰我，蠢驴！

say:56:1222620040:0.text: I'll tape your mouth shut if you keep yapping.
say:56:1222620040:0.source_cn: 再废话就把你的嘴也封起来。

say:63:1222620041:0.text: Chippy, Chippy! Come over here—there's something we have to tell you.
say:63:1222620041:0.source_cn: 满满、满满！过来一下，我们有事要和你说。

choice_prompt:64:1222620041.text: Chippy, Chippy! Come over here—there's something we have to tell you.
choice_prompt:64:1222620041.source_cn: 满满、满满！过来一下，我们有事要和你说。

say:65:1222620042:0.text: ...We'll let her go, then follow her tracks to the Void Relic... Chippy copies you, loud and clear!
say:65:1222620042:0.source_cn: ……先故意放走，再一路追踪她，直到拿到被藏起来的圣器…...

say:66:1222620043:1.text: Yep. Lucca seems to be ready, as well.
say:66:1222620043:1.source_cn: 明白就好，卢卡那边的准备好像也结束了。

say:69:1222620044:0.source_cn: 已经把波妮捆得“结结实实”了。

say:70:1222620045:1.text: Let's take her back to the Carmine Whispers.

choice:64:0:1.source_cn: （告知准备刻意放走波妮的计划）

say:72:1222620033:0.text: I'll keep an eye out. If we can't find the Void Relic and Bonnie escapes again, I'll be too ashamed to return.
say:72:1222620033:0.source_cn: 我会多留意。万一圣器没找到，又让波妮跑了，我没脸回去见...
say:72:1222620033:0.male: I'll keep an eye out. If we can't find the Void Relic and Bonnie escapes again, I'll be too ashamed to return.
say:72:1222620033:0.female: I'll keep an eye out. If we can't find the Void Relic and Bonnie escapes again, I'll be too ashamed to return.

choice:44:1:2.text: I think we should be careful.
choice:44:1:2.male: I think we should be careful.
choice:44:1:2.female: I think we should be careful.

choice:35:0:1.text: We don't need her to talk.
choice:35:0:1.source_cn: 我们不需要波妮的口供
choice:35:0:1.male: We don't need her to talk.
choice:35:0:1.female: We don't need her to talk.

choice:35:1:2.source_cn: 我们只需要班题斯圣器

choice:6:0:1.text: What a pathetic attempt at a lie.
choice:6:0:1.male: What a pathetic attempt at a lie.
choice:6:0:1.female: What a pathetic attempt at a lie.

say:0:1222621001:0.text: It's getting dark, let's light a campfire and rest for a bit.
say:0:1222621001:0.source_cn: 天黑了，点个篝火，稍作修整吧。

say:4:1222622001:1.text: With Bonnie caught, getting the info about the relic from her will be easy as pie.
say:4:1222622001:1.source_cn: 波妮人抓到了，从她口中逼问出圣器的所在地轻而易举。

say:5:1222622002:0.text: I'll return her to the Carmine Whispers tomorrow for a proper interrogation. For now, let's rest.
say:5:1222622002:0.source_cn: 明天带她回血薇帮再好好审问。先休息吧。

choice_prompt:6:1222622002.text: I'll return her to the Carmine Whispers tomorrow for a proper interrogation. For now, let's rest.
choice_prompt:6:1222622002.source_cn: 明天带她回血薇帮好好审问。先休息吧。

say:7:1222622003:1.text: Oh, Magister, you must rest well! Let Chippy and I handle the watch!
say:7:1222622003:1.source_cn: 是呀，不能让梅林守夜，还是让我们来。
say:7:1222622003:1.male: Oh, Magister, you must rest well! Let Chippy and I handle the watch!
say:7:1222622003:1.female: Oh, Magister, you must rest well! Let Chippy and I handle the watch!

say:8:1222622005:1.text: Chippy, why don't you take the first half of the night, and I'll handle the second half?
say:8:1222622005:1.source_cn: 满满，你守前半夜，我负责后半夜。

say:9:1222622006:1.text: Actually, Chippy's full of energy! Chippy can do the whole night!
say:9:1222622006:1.source_cn: 我精神百倍，守一整晚也没问题。

say:10:1222622007:1.text: Well, since you're so confident, I'll leave it to you. But you'd better make sure Bonnie doesn't escape!
say:10:1222622007:1.source_cn: 既然你这么有自信，那就交给你啦，可千万不能让波妮逃走哦。

say:11:1222622008:1.text: Of course! Nothing will go wrong with Sir Chippy here!

narration:16:1222622009:0.text: Everyone deliberately talks loud enough so that Bonnie can hear you from nearby.
narration:16:1222622009:0.source_cn: 大家故意提高音量，让不远处的波妮听清了这些话

say:17:1222622010:1.text: Hmph... leaving just one hamster to keep watch? These fools underestimate me.
say:17:1222622010:1.source_cn: 哼……留一只老鼠守夜，未免太小瞧我了。

say:19:1222622004:1.text: Of course, this is my duty!
say:19:1222622004:1.source_cn: 没问题，这是我们的责任！

choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 守夜就交给满满和漫漫了！

say:8:1222623001:1.text: She got away, just as planned. Good thing I tied the ropes loosely.
say:8:1222623001:1.source_cn: 很好，她成功逃走了，没有辜负我故意弄松的绳索。

say:9:1222623002:0.text: Let's hurry and catch up to her! It'll be terrible if she goes too far and we lose her.
say:9:1222623002:0.source_cn: 我们赶紧追上去吧！万一她真的逃跑，那可得不偿失了。

say:14:1222623006:1.text: Ah! Huh? Is it morning already?

say:15:1222623007:1.text: Chippy, you big idiot! We agreed you had to put on an act. How could you fall asleep for real?!
say:15:1222623007:1.source_cn: 满满大笨蛋！说好了是演戏，你怎么真的睡着了呀！

say:16:1222623008:1.text:
Sorry!
Chippy was pretending to sleep at first... but then...
say:16:1222623008:1.source_cn: 对不起！\n我一开始是装睡……但装着装着，就……

say:17:1222623009:1.text: Haha! It's alright. Bonnie's quite cautious. Honestly, you falling asleep for real might have helped lower her guard.
say:17:1222623009:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈！没关系。波妮警觉谨慎，你没装睡，而是真的睡着了...

say:18:1222623010:1.source_cn: 我们立刻追上去，一定会让她措手不及！

narration:20:12602210:0.text: Bonnie breaks free and escapes while you are asleep.
narration:20:12602210:0.source_cn: 趁着你们都睡着，波妮挣脱了束缚跑了。

say:0:1222624001:0.text: These bloodstains... Looks like Bonnie's hurt.
say:0:1222624001:0.source_cn: 是血迹，看起来波妮受伤了。

say:0:1222625001:0.text: And there are footprints. We're on the right track.
say:0:1222625001:0.source_cn: 这里还有很清晰的脚印，方向没错。

say:3:1222626001:1.text: Wait, why did the footprints suddenly disappear?
say:3:1222626001:1.source_cn: 咦，脚印怎么突然消失了？

say:6:1222626003:1.text: Could it be... Bonnie left those footprints on purpose?
say:6:1222626003:1.source_cn: 难道说……这些脚印从一开始就是波妮故意留下的？

say:7:1222626004:1.text: Leaving fake trails and smokescreens... just like how Hodgkin loved to do. These Graveborn are despicable.
say:7:1222626004:1.source_cn: 逃跑时还不忘放烟雾弹，不愧是霍德希金的爱将。

say:8:1222626005:1.text: The footprints were fake? Oh no, we've probably gone in circles. She's gotten away for sure!
say:8:1222626005:1.source_cn: 脚印是假的？那不是糟糕了吗？我们兜了圈子，她肯定已经跑远了！

say:9:1222626006:1.text: Not necessarily. She left those clues to mislead us, which probably slowed her down.
say:9:1222626006:1.source_cn: 不见得，她故意留下痕迹误导我们，反而耽搁了自己逃跑的时间。

say:10:1222626007:1.text: Exactly, and we let her go on purpose. She wouldn't have expected that.
say:10:1222626007:1.source_cn: 对哦，我们也是故意放她离开的，她一定没想到。

say:11:1222626008:1.text: She can't be far. Let's take a different path and continue the chase!
say:11:1222626008:1.source_cn: 没错，所以我猜她没跑远。换另外一条路，继续追吧！

say:0:1222627001:0.text: This path is untouched. It must've been cleaned up. Let's follow it!
say:0:1222627001:0.source_cn: 这条路上没有任何痕迹，应该是专门清理过。追吧！

say:3:1222630001:0.text: No, the Void Relic... it can't end up back in the hands of the <style="highlight">Empire</style>!
say:3:1222630001:0.source_cn: 不行，班题斯圣器……绝对不能回到<style=high...

say:4:1222630002:1.text: The Empire? Bonnie, who was that lady?
say:4:1222630002:1.source_cn: 帝国？波妮，你究竟认不认识那个女孩子？

say:5:1222630003:1.text: I've never met her before, but I know exactly who she is. She's an assassin from the Bantus Empire, one of Thoran's lapdogs!
say:5:1222630003:1.source_cn: 我没见过她，但知道她是谁——她是班题斯帝国的杀手，是托...

say:6:1222630004:1.text: Those heartless monsters tracked us all the way here...
say:6:1222630004:1.source_cn: 那群冷血的怪物……竟然追到这里来了。

choice_prompt:7:1222630004.text: Those heartless monsters tracked us all the way here...
choice_prompt:7:1222630004.source_cn: 那群冷血的怪物……竟然追到这里来了。

say:8:1222630005:0.text: Stay away from Thoran's domain unless you wish to die. No one ever leaves there alive.
say:8:1222630005:0.source_cn: 除非你决定走向死亡，否则不要接近托安的领域，任何生灵都...
say:8:1222630005:0.male: Stay away from Thoran's domain unless you wish to die. No one ever leaves there alive.
say:8:1222630005:0.female: Stay away from Thoran's domain unless you wish to die. No one ever leaves there alive.

say:9:1222630006:0.text: That's all I can tell you. Funny, isn't it? Asking one enemy about another.
say:9:1222630006:0.source_cn: 其余的我并不清楚。真可笑，你竟然向一个敌人打听另一伙敌人。
say:9:1222630006:0.male: That's all I can tell you. Funny, isn't it? Asking one enemy about another.
say:9:1222630006:0.female: That's all I can tell you. Funny, isn't it? Asking one enemy about another.

choice:7:0:1.text: Tell me about the Bantus Empire.
choice:7:0:1.male: Tell me about the Bantus Empire.
choice:7:0:1.female: Tell me about the Bantus Empire.

say:10:1222630007:0.text: <style="highlight">Thoran, the Fallen King</style>... Since you know about the Bantus Empire, you must have heard of him.
say:10:1222630007:0.male: <style="highlight">Thoran, the Fallen King</style>... Since you know about the Bantus Empire, you must have heard of him.
say:10:1222630007:0.female: <style="highlight">Thoran, the Fallen King</style>... Since you know about the Bantus Empire, you must have heard of him.

say:11:1222630008:0.text: I've never met that terrifying ruler myself, but Captain Hodgkin's hatred for him runs deep.
say:11:1222630008:0.source_cn: 我未曾见过那位可怕的君主，霍德希金船长对他的怨恨刻入骨...
say:11:1222630008:0.male: I've never met that terrifying ruler myself, but Captain Hodgkin's hatred for him runs deep.
say:11:1222630008:0.female: I've never met that terrifying ruler myself, but Captain Hodgkin's hatred for him runs deep.

say:12:1222630009:0.text: We saw a wanted poster on the ship that said Hodgkin stole some important relic from Bantus.
say:12:1222630009:0.source_cn: 在不死号的船舱里，有一张霍德希金的通缉令，通缉令上说，...
say:12:1222630009:0.male: We saw a wanted poster on the ship that said Hodgkin stole some important relic from Bantus.
say:12:1222630009:0.female: We saw a wanted poster on the ship that said Hodgkin stole some important relic from Bantus.

say:13:1222630010:0.text: That's just slander. The relic itself chose the captain.
say:13:1222630010:0.source_cn: 无聊的诽谤……我相信是圣器选择了船长。
say:13:1222630010:0.male: That's just slander. The relic itself chose the captain.
say:13:1222630010:0.female: That's just slander. The relic itself chose the captain.

say:14:1222630011:0.text: Hmph... I've never heard her true name, but everyone in the empire knows her as the Silver Reaper.
say:14:1222630011:0.source_cn: 哼……我不知道她的名字，只是偶尔听人提起她的代号——苍...
say:14:1222630011:0.male: Hmph... I've never heard her true name, but everyone in the empire knows her as the Silver Reaper.
say:14:1222630011:0.female: Hmph... I've never heard her true name, but everyone in the empire knows her as the Silver Reaper.

say:15:1222630012:0.text: Rumor has it she has a sister, and both of them are favored by Thoran.
say:15:1222630012:0.source_cn: 传闻，那家伙有个妹妹，她们姐妹都受到托安的信任和喜爱。
say:15:1222630012:0.male: Rumor has it she has a sister, and both of them are favored by Thoran.
say:15:1222630012:0.female: Rumor has it she has a sister, and both of them are favored by Thoran.

say:16:1222630013:0.text: Apparently, they got into his good graces due to their noble father.
say:16:1222630013:0.source_cn: 不过，这似乎还要多亏那二人有个出身高贵的父亲。
say:16:1222630013:0.male: Apparently, they got into his good graces due to their noble father.
say:16:1222630013:0.female: Apparently, they got into his good graces due to their noble father.

say:17:1222630014:0.text: I must have lost my mind, to be answering your questions like this...
say:17:1222630014:0.source_cn: 竟然会乖乖回答你的问题……我一定是疯了。
say:17:1222630014:0.male: I must have lost my mind, to be answering your questions like this...
say:17:1222630014:0.female: I must have lost my mind, to be answering your questions like this...

say:18:1222630015:0.text: Better hope your friends are skilled enough to get the relic back from her.
say:18:1222630015:0.source_cn: 但愿你们的朋友足够有用，能从那个苍白处刑者手中抢回班题...

say:19:1222630016:1.text: Oh, when I saw that lady earlier, her gaze was so still and empty.
say:19:1222630016:1.source_cn: 刚才与那个女孩子对视的时候，我看到她的眼神非常平静。

say:20:1222630017:1.text: She follows orders without question—she's a true puppet, devoid of her own will, killing anyone who stands in her way.
say:20:1222630017:1.source_cn: 服从命令，执行命令，她没有自己的思想，是真正的行尸走肉。

say:21:1222630018:1.text: But it seemed like she was holding back against you. I mean, you're still breathing, aren't you?
say:21:1222630018:1.source_cn: 可是，她好像没有对你下狠手。

say:22:1222630019:1.text: That's because she was just gathering intel. If she really wanted me dead, I wouldn't be standing here. Don't be foolish enough to underestimate her.
say:22:1222630019:1.source_cn: 那是因为她还想打探更多的情报，况且她的攻击毫不留情，精...

say:23:1222630020:1.text: And don't mistake her for some lost lamb you can save. I know you've naively tried to redeem Nara before, but this is different—don't get your hopes up.
say:23:1222630020:1.source_cn: 你们不会把敌人想象成善良无害的绵羊吧？真不敢相信你们是...

say:25:1222630022:1.text: In any case, don't treat her like any ordinary enemy. She's faster than I am, and that big brute from earlier won't stand a chance against her.
say:25:1222630022:1.source_cn: 总之，别把她当成普通的杂兵！她行动比我还灵活，那个肌肉...

choice_prompt:26:1222630022.text: In any case, don't treat her like any ordinary enemy. She's faster than I am, and that big brute from earlier won't stand a chance against her.
choice_prompt:26:1222630022.source_cn: 总之，别把她当成普通的杂兵！她行动比我还灵活，那个肌肉大块头恐怕不是她的对手。

say:27:1222630023:1.text: Good timing! The Carmine Whispers' reinforcements have arrived. We'll hand Bonnie over to them and go to Lucca!
say:27:1222630023:1.source_cn: 好！正好血薇帮的援手赶来了，把波妮交给血薇帮，我们去帮卢卡！

say:0:1222631001:0.text: You must take back the Void Relic!

say:3:1222632002:0.text: He's badly injured... there's blood everywhere, and every wound is critical! That assassin is way too cruel!
say:3:1222632002:0.source_cn: 伤得好重……到处都是血，每一道伤都在要害！那家伙，下手...

say:5:1222632003:0.text: *Cough* I'm... still alive... She just used the terrain...
say:5:1222632003:0.source_cn: 咳……咳咳！我还……还死不了……她只是，凭着地形……咳咳……

say:7:1222632005:0.text: Stop talking! Slow your breathing, it'll help with the bleeding.
say:7:1222632005:0.source_cn: 你别说话了！放慢呼吸，有利于止血。

say:8:1222632006:1.text: We'll take care of the rest!
say:8:1222632006:1.source_cn: 这个家伙，交给我们来对付！

say:6:1222634002:1.text: No! The second-in-command is losing a lot of blood! Is he...
say:6:1222634002:1.source_cn: 不、不好了，二当家流了好多血！他是不是——

say:7:1222634003:1.text: Don't jinx it! Sir Lucca is just unconscious.
say:7:1222634003:1.source_cn: 别说晦气话，卢卡只是暂时昏迷了。

say:8:1222634004:1.text: What are you two doing here, anyway? Where's Bonnie?
say:8:1222634004:1.source_cn: 倒是你们两个，怎么跑到这边来了？波妮呢！

say:9:1222634005:1.text: That Graveborn woman has been taken back to headquarters. We wanted to see if there's anything we can do here.
say:9:1222634005:1.source_cn: 那个女亡灵已经被弟兄们押回总部了，我们想着你们估计也需...

say:10:1222634006:0.text: Chippy actually needs your help! Take Lucca back to Rustport, and quickly, he needs treatment! Make sure he doesn't tear his wounds.
say:10:1222634006:0.source_cn: 正好需要你们帮忙！小心点，不要扯到卢卡的伤口，快把他送...

say:11:1222634007:0.text: We also need to explain things to Sonja. Things have gotten a little tricky...
say:11:1222634007:0.source_cn: 另外，我们还得去找索尼娅说明现在的情况。有些棘手……

say:3:1222635001:1.text: Lucca's still out cold... We need to discuss our next step.
say:3:1222635001:1.source_cn: 卢卡还在昏迷中……我们先聊聊吧。
say:3:1222635001:1.male: Lucca's still out cold... We need to discuss our next step.
say:3:1222635001:1.female: Lucca's still out cold... We need to discuss our next step.

say:4:1222635002:1.text: Can you explain what exactly happened?
say:4:1222635002:1.source_cn: 方便和我说说事情的详细经过吗？

narration:5:1222635003:0.text: You and the others tell Sonja everything that happened so far...
narration:5:1222635003:0.source_cn: 将这一路的遭遇转述给索尼娅后——

say:6:1222635004:1.text: So an assassin from the Bantus Empire stole the Void Relic...
say:6:1222635004:1.source_cn: 班题斯帝国的杀手抢走了圣器……

say:7:1222635005:1.text: We might have caught a big fish with this trap, but it cost us dearly.
say:7:1222635005:1.source_cn: 这次撒饵抛钩，似乎钓上了一条大鱼，但我们也付出了不小的代价。

say:8:1222635006:1.text: *Sniffle* Lucca will be alright, won't he?

say:9:1222635007:1.text: He's not in immediate danger, but that assassin was brutal. Every blow hit a vital spot—he's seriously hurt.
say:9:1222635007:1.source_cn: 没有生命危险，但那名杀手毫不留情，每一刀都直击要害，卢...

say:10:1222635008:1.text: Speaking of which, Bonnie's hurt too, but her injuries aren't as bad.
say:10:1222635008:1.source_cn: 说起来，波妮身上也有伤，却伤得并不重，这让我有些想不通。

say:11:1222635009:1.text: Why would the assassin hold back against Bonnie?
say:11:1222635009:1.source_cn: 那个杀手为什么会对波妮手下留情？

choice_prompt:12:1222635009.text: Why would the assassin hold back against Bonnie?
choice_prompt:12:1222635009.source_cn: 那个杀手为什么会对波妮手下留情？

say:13:1222635010:1.text: Wasn't Bonnie created by Hodgkin using the Void Relic? That must've happened after he left the empire. Would that assassin know her?
say:13:1222635010:1.source_cn: 波妮是霍德希金离开班题斯帝国后才收为下属的吧？那个杀手...

say:14:1222635011:1.text: Hm... Probably not, since Bonnie doesn't even know her name.
say:14:1222635011:1.source_cn: 嗯……至少波妮完全不知道她的名字呢，应该不太熟吧。

say:15:1222635013:1.text: Could it be because they're both women?
say:15:1222635013:1.source_cn: 总不会因为都是女性，所以手下留情了吧？

say:16:1222635014:1.text: We can't rule that out, I suppose.

say:17:1222635015:1.text: Interesting. At least we can assume she's more likely to spare women.
say:17:1222635015:1.source_cn: 有意思。至少，我们对她不是一无所知了。

say:18:1222635016:1.text: That could be useful for our strategy.
say:18:1222635016:1.source_cn: 如果她会对女性手下留情，我们的应对策略可以考虑这一点。

say:21:1222635017:1.text: Anders, reporting! The items you requested are ready!
say:21:1222635017:1.source_cn: 报告！您要的东西我们已经做好了，请过目！

say:23:1222635018:1.text: Well done. As for your next task, post them all over Rustport.
say:23:1222635018:1.source_cn: 很好，辛苦了。你们还有新的任务，把它们张贴在锈锚港各处。

say:24:1222635019:1.source_cn: 索尼娅，这好像是……通缉令？

say:25:1222635020:1.source_cn: 不错，通缉令上的画像，出自波妮之手。

choice_prompt:27:1222635020.source_cn: 不错，通缉令上的画像，出自波妮之手。

say:28:1222635021:0.text: It's surprising, isn't it? She's captured the assassin's features quite well. She has some talent.
say:28:1222635021:0.source_cn: 是啊，人物特点突出，她有些艺术天分。

say:29:1222635022:1.text: Regardless, I didn't expect Bonnie to cooperate, but she's been a big help.
say:29:1222635022:1.source_cn: 不管怎么说，我也没想到波妮愿意配合，帮大忙了。

say:30:1222635023:1.text: Are you hoping to get help from the locals in Rustport?
say:30:1222635023:1.source_cn: 你打算借助锈锚港居民的力量，抓住那个杀手吗？

say:31:1222635024:1.text: Yes. Now that she's got the relic, her next move will be to flee.
say:31:1222635024:1.source_cn: 是的。既然那人已经得到了圣器，她一定想尽快离开锈锚港。

say:32:1222635025:1.text: She'll probably try to escape by sea.
say:32:1222635025:1.source_cn: 她唯一的选择，是坐船出海。

say:33:1222635026:1.text: With these posters everywhere and a huge bounty on her head, it's only a matter of time before we catch her, unless she somehow grows wings.
say:33:1222635026:1.source_cn: 这些通缉令将遍布全城，我开出了高昂的赏金，除非她能展翅...

say:34:1222635027:1.text: The Carmine Whispers will settle this with blood. She won't slip past us!
say:34:1222635027:1.source_cn: 血薇帮以血还血，在我的地盘放肆，她逃不走！

say:37:1222635028:1.text: Is there anything we can do to help? Chippy wants to help Lucca out!
say:37:1222635028:1.source_cn: 索尼娅，有我们能帮上忙的地方吗？我们也想替卢卡出份力！

say:38:1222635029:1.source_cn: 那我就不客气地拜托各位了。

say:39:1222635030:0.text: First, please put up some of these wanted posters. I've sent out many of my men to strengthen the patrols, so we're a little short-handed.
say:39:1222635030:0.source_cn: 首先得麻烦各位帮忙张贴一些通缉令，为了加强巡防，我们派...

say:40:1222635031:1.text: Also, head to the docks and let the guards know to be extra vigilant.
say:40:1222635031:1.source_cn: 另外，请去码头给那里的警卫带个话，告诉他们务必提高警惕。

say:41:1222635032:1.text: Finally, I need you to visit an informant named Grayfang. Have him report any recent rumors, and make sure he's telling the truth.
say:41:1222635032:1.source_cn: 最后，想让各位去找一位情报贩子，他的外号叫灰舌，让他把...

say:42:1222635033:1.text: O-oh! That's quite a list of tasks... You weren't kidding when you said you'd rely on us!
say:42:1222635033:1.source_cn: 还真是不客气呢……竟然有这么多任务。

say:43:1222635034:1.text: Sorry, but the situation is urgent.
say:43:1222635034:1.source_cn: 抱歉，因为情况着实紧急。

say:44:1222635035:1.text: It's fine, we'll take it one step at a time!
say:44:1222635035:1.source_cn: 没关系，我们一样一样来。

choice:27:1:2.text: I bet I could do better.
choice:27:1:2.male: I bet I could do better.
choice:27:1:2.female: I bet I could do better.

say:46:1222635012:1.text: But the Graveborn don't really care about each other as kin.
say:46:1222635012:1.source_cn: 可是对于亡灵来说，他们彼此之间没什么认同感，也不在乎所...

say:0:1222637001:0.text: Posting wanted posters, notifying the guards, and dealing with a shady informant...
say:0:1222637001:0.source_cn: 张贴通缉令，通知守卫，还要和黑市的家伙谈谈。

say:1:1222637002:0.text: Looks like the Carmine Whispers' net is tightening. We've got this!
say:1:1222637002:0.source_cn: 这就是血薇帮的天罗地网，交给我们吧！

say:0:1222638001:0.text: The posters are up. Let's hope someone finds a lead.
say:0:1222638001:0.source_cn: 通缉令贴好了，希望有人为了赏金提供线索。
say:0:1222638001:0.male: The posters are up. Let's hope someone finds a lead.
say:0:1222638001:0.female: The posters are up. Let's hope someone finds a lead.

say:0:1222639001:0.text: Here comes another wave of bloodshed...

say:2:1222640001:1.text:
Hey, you—
Oh, if it isn't the Magister! Sorry i didn't recognize you sooner!
say:2:1222640001:1.source_cn: 我说你们几个——\n啊，这不是魔法师大人吗？怪我眼拙，...
say:2:1222640001:1.male:
Hey, you—
Oh, if it isn't the Magister! Sorry i didn't recognize you sooner!
say:2:1222640001:1.female:
Hey, you—
Oh, if it isn't the Magister! Sorry i didn't recognize you sooner!

say:3:1222640002:1.text: Are you here for me? If you're in trouble, I'll do everything I can to help!
say:3:1222640002:1.source_cn: 您是专门来找我的吗？要是遇到了麻烦，我一定竭尽全力为您解决！
say:3:1222640002:1.male: Are you here for me? If you're in trouble, I'll do everything I can to help!
say:3:1222640002:1.female: Are you here for me? If you're in trouble, I'll do everything I can to help!

choice_prompt:4:1222640002.text: Are you here for me? If you're in trouble, I'll do everything I can to help!
choice_prompt:4:1222640002.source_cn: 您是专门来找我的吗？要是遇到了麻烦，我一定竭尽全力为您解决！
choice_prompt:4:1222640002.male: Are you here for me? If you're in trouble, I'll do everything I can to help!
choice_prompt:4:1222640002.female: Are you here for me? If you're in trouble, I'll do everything I can to help!

say:5:1222640003:0.text: Yes, thanks to Tritonus' blessing! It's been peaceful lately.
say:5:1222640003:0.source_cn: 一切正常，多亏特勒米琉斯眷顾，最近风平浪静。

say:6:1222640004:0.text: We inspect every ship that comes and goes. No contraband or suspicious people so far.
say:6:1222640004:0.source_cn: 进港船只和离岸船只我们都会严格搜查，没发现违禁品和可疑人员。

say:7:1222640005:0.text: Not recently, but I'll definitely keep an eye out for you!
say:7:1222640005:0.source_cn: 目前我没注意到任何可疑的人，我会提高警惕，多多留心。

say:8:1222640006:0.text: You have to be very careful! There's a Graveborn hiding in Rustport. We suspect she might try to stow away and escape on a boat.
say:8:1222640006:0.source_cn: 千万不能大意，有个亡灵藏在锈锚港，我们怀疑她会试图偷渡...

say:9:1222640007:1.text: A Graveborn here?! I'll be vigilant, please don't worry. I'll make sure the others are too.
say:9:1222640007:1.source_cn: 居然还有这么嚣张的家伙！我知道了，各位请放心吧。

say:10:1222640008:1.text: I'll keep an extra close watch on everything, even the birds that fly over the port!
say:10:1222640008:1.source_cn: 从今天开始，港口上面飞过几只鸟我都会数得清清楚楚！

say:0:1222641001:0.text: We've notified the dock guards. What's next?
say:0:1222641001:0.source_cn: 警卫先生通知完了，那么接下来……

say:3:1222643001:1.text: Oh, it's you. What brings you to my corner? Just a humble merchant here, nothing special.
say:3:1222643001:1.source_cn: 诸、诸位，找我有什么事啊？我可是个本本分分的好商人……

say:4:1222643002:1.text: If you're "just" a merchant, then I'm the head of the Templar Knights!
say:4:1222643002:1.source_cn: 你要是好商人，那卢卡就是耀光圣堂的圣骑士了。

say:5:1222643003:0.source_cn: 先生，我们是受索尼娅委托，专程来找你的。

say:6:1222643004:1.text: The Whispers boss sent you? That's strange. It's usually Lucca who comes around.
say:6:1222643004:1.source_cn: 血薇帮的当家找我做什么……往常来找我的都是卢卡。

say:7:1222643005:1.text: Lucca's not available at the moment. Anyways, Sonja values your information network. Heard anything unusual lately?
say:7:1222643005:1.source_cn: 卢卡有他的任务。索尼娅很看重你的情报网，最近有什么风吹...

say:8:1222643006:1.text: Rustport's full of oddities—like old Mori's chicken finally kicked the bucket. Need to know about that too?
say:8:1222643006:1.source_cn: 呵呵，锈锚港每天发生的事情可太多了，比如老莫里家的鸡刚...

say:9:1222643007:1.text: Stop wasting time, you know we're asking about something more important.
say:9:1222643007:1.source_cn: 不要耍嘴皮子，你知道我们想听更重要的情报。

say:12:1222643009:1.text: The Whispers lifted the fog. No one's crazy enough to smuggle folks now. It's too risky, not worth the coin.
say:12:1222643009:1.source_cn: 血薇帮解除了海禁，谁会在这时做偷渡生意啊？没必要挣那个...

say:13:1222643011:1.text: Seems like there isn't anything big.

say:14:1222643012:1.text: We're actually here because of a Graveborn assassin hiding in Rustport. We think she's looking for a ship to sneak away on.
say:14:1222643012:1.source_cn: 有个亡灵杀手潜藏在锈锚港，她很可能在暗地寻找船只，偷渡离港。

say:15:1222643013:1.text: Right, I got roots in Rustport too. I ain't gonna sit back while the Graveborn mess up the trade.
say:15:1222643013:1.source_cn: 我知道了，我也是靠着锈锚港吃饭的人，不会眼睁睁看着亡灵...

say:16:1222643014:1.text: I'll send word to the captains, have the foremen keep their eyes peeled. Let's see who's bold enough to back a Graveborn!
say:16:1222643014:1.source_cn: 我会放话出去，让工头和船长们互相监督，看谁敢帮助亡灵偷渡！

say:17:1222643015:1.text: Good! If you find any leads, report to the Carmine Whispers. You'll be well rewarded.
say:17:1222643015:1.source_cn: 很好，如果你有相关的线索，记得随时告诉血薇帮，报酬优厚。

say:18:1222643016:1.text: Hey, a little coin always gets the job done—you can count on me.
say:18:1222643016:1.source_cn: 啊哈哈，没问题，谁会不喜欢亮闪闪的钱币呢？包在我身上！

say:20:1222643010:1.text: Hmm. Recently, there's been a flood of cheap liquor on the market.
say:20:1222643010:1.source_cn: 最近有些酒水以极低的价格流入市场，我估计就是前几天混进...

say:0:1222644001:0.text: Is that guy even trustworthy...? Eh, whatever, let's give him a chance.
say:0:1222644001:0.source_cn: 那家伙靠得住吗……总之，先相信他吧。

say:2:1222645001:1.text: We've posted the wanted posters, alerted the guards, and made contact with the informant. We've completed all of Sonja's tasks.
say:2:1222645001:1.source_cn: 张贴通缉令，提醒港口的守卫，和情报商人达成合作……很好...

say:3:1222645002:1.text: Now it'll be much harder for that assassin to slip away.
say:3:1222645002:1.source_cn: 这下子，那杀手想要离港就更加困难了。

choice_prompt:4:1222645002.text: Now it'll be much harder for that assassin to slip away.
choice_prompt:4:1222645002.source_cn: 这下子，那杀手想要离港就更加困难了。

say:5:1222645003:1.source_cn: 我们的部署这么全面，一定没问题。

say:6:1222645005:1.text: You've been busy for so long! Why not take a break?
say:6:1222645005:1.source_cn: 主人，忙了这么久，你休息一会儿。
say:6:1222645005:1.male: You've been busy for so long! Why not take a break?
say:6:1222645005:1.female: You've been busy for so long! Why not take a break?

say:7:1222645006:1.text: Let's wait and see what happens.
say:7:1222645006:1.source_cn: 这段时间，我们等等结果吧。

choice:4:0:1.text: Let's wait for the trap to spring.
choice:4:0:1.male: Let's wait for the trap to spring.
choice:4:0:1.female: Let's wait for the trap to spring.

say:9:1222645004:1.text: Magister, don't overthink it. Let's trust Sonja's plan.
say:9:1222645004:1.source_cn: 梅林，别给自己太大压力，眼下，我们先相信索尼娅的判断吧。
say:9:1222645004:1.male: Magister, don't overthink it. Let's trust Sonja's plan.
say:9:1222645004:1.female: Magister, don't overthink it. Let's trust Sonja's plan.

narration:0:1222646001:1.text: A few days later, with nothing out of the ordinary...

say:5:1222647003:1.text: Sorry for the trouble. Must've been quite the ordeal hauling a big guy like me all the way back to Rustport, huh?
say:5:1222647003:1.source_cn: 麻烦你们了。把我这大块头搬回锈锚港是不是挺费劲？

say:6:1222647004:1.text: If you're gonna thank anyone, give credit to the two behind you.
say:6:1222647004:1.source_cn: 要谢就谢你身后的两位同伴吧。

say:7:1222647005:1.text: They're the ones who brought me back?
say:7:1222647005:1.source_cn: 是他们两个把我带回来的？

say:10:1222647006:1.text: Heh... Second-in-command, yep, it was us!

say:11:1222647007:1.text: I was wondering why you kept rubbing your backs. Guess lugging around a useless lump like me wore you out.
say:11:1222647007:1.source_cn: 我说你们怎么老是捶后腰，原来是累着了。

say:14:1222647008:1.text: Boss! Don't talk like that—you're not just dead weight! You're the heart and soul of the Whispers!
say:14:1222647008:1.source_cn: 二当家！别把自己说得像是一坨肉，您可是血薇帮不可或缺的...

say:15:1222647009:1.text: You two... usually love taking all the credit. Why so shy all of a sudden?
say:15:1222647009:1.source_cn: 你们两个……平时喜欢抢功劳，怎么这回谦虚起来了？

say:16:1222647010:1.text: Well... we can't exactly say it's because we might've dropped you off the cart and, uh... you hit your head...
say:16:1222647010:1.source_cn: 总不能说是因为搬运过程中不小心让您掉下马车，撞到了头……

say:18:1222647012:1.text: Alright, alright. I'll let it slide this time. And...
say:18:1222647012:1.source_cn: 行了。我不会追究你们的过失。还有……

say:21:1222647015:1.source_cn: 呜呜呜……二当家真是好人啊！

say:22:1222647016:1.text: Alright, enough with the waterworks. Sonja's looking for us.
say:22:1222647016:1.source_cn: 好了，别站在这里闲聊了，索尼娅有事找我们。

say:23:1222647017:1.text: She's organized all the intel we've gathered, let's go meet her.
say:23:1222647017:1.source_cn: 她将这段时间收集到的信息整理了一番，我们去找她吧。

say:0:1222648001:0.text: Clues... I've got them! Give me the reward!

say:1:1222648002:0.source_cn: 哎呀，明明是人家先来的！

say:3:1222650002:0.text: All of them are chasing that big bounty, eager to spill whatever info they've got.
say:3:1222650002:0.source_cn: 为了高昂的赏金，不少人愿意提供情报。

say:4:1222650003:1.text: But most of it's a mix of truth and nonsense, so we'll have to carefully sift through it.
say:4:1222650003:1.source_cn: 但是这些情报真假掺杂，需要仔细分辨。

say:5:1222650004:1.text: Got it. I'll talk to them one by one.
say:5:1222650004:1.source_cn: 明白了，我会挨个和他们聊聊。

say:2:1222651001:1.text: Those two guys over there? Total con men, trying to scam the bounty. But my info? It's real, I swear on my life!
say:2:1222651001:1.source_cn: 那两个家伙只想骗取赏金，我的情报才保真，我敢用自己这条...

say:4:1222651003:1.text: I've got two small boats tied up at the pier. One of 'em I barely use.
say:4:1222651003:1.source_cn: 我有两艘小船停靠在码头，其中一艘不常用，一直栓在船坞里。

say:5:1222651004:1.text: But yesterday, I found the rope cut!
say:5:1222651004:1.source_cn: 可我昨天发现，那艘船的绳子被割开了！

say:6:1222651005:1.text: I saw the criminal with my own eyes! She was trying to steal my boat! If I hadn't shown up when I did, it would've been gone!
say:6:1222651005:1.source_cn: 我亲眼看见通缉犯了！她想偷我的船！要不是我去的及时，我...

choice_prompt:7:1222651005.text: I saw the criminal with my own eyes! She was trying to steal my boat! If I hadn't shown up when I did, it would've been gone!
choice_prompt:7:1222651005.source_cn: 我亲眼看见通缉犯了！她想偷我的船！要不是我去的及时，我的船就没了！

say:8:1222651006:1.text: Yes! Even though it was dark, I saw her clear as day—it was a woman. It had to be her!
say:8:1222651006:1.source_cn: 对啊！虽然当时天很黑，但我看见了，那是个女的，肯定是通缉犯！

say:9:1222651008:1.text: The rope's been cut a little more each day. I've noticed it three times!
say:9:1222651008:1.source_cn: 从昨天开始，绑船的绳子每天都会被割断一点点，我发现三次了！

choice_prompt:10:1222651008.text: The rope's been cut a little more each day. I've noticed it three times!
choice_prompt:10:1222651008.source_cn: 从昨天开始，绑船的绳子每天都会被割断一点点，我发现三次了！

say:11:1222651009:1.text: Uh... no, wait, including today, it's been two days, so I've noticed it twice!
say:11:1222651009:1.source_cn: 呃……不对，昨天加上今天是两天，也就是说我发现了两次！

say:12:1222651010:1.text: How many times exactly? Your story isn't adding up.
say:12:1222651010:1.source_cn: 到底是几次……你的话有些可疑。

say:13:1222651012:1.text: It's a solid boat, perfect for long trips!
say:13:1222651012:1.source_cn: 反正，我那船可是一艘好船，吃水深！能远航！

choice_prompt:14:1222651012.text: It's a solid boat, perfect for long trips!
choice_prompt:14:1222651012.source_cn: 反正，我那船可是一艘好船，吃水深！能远航！

say:15:1222651013:1.text: Did I say that? You must've heard wrong.

say:16:1222651016:1.text: Anyway, something happened to my boat, so it must be the criminal!
say:16:1222651016:1.source_cn: 总之，我的船遭到这种事，肯定除了通缉犯没有别人！

choice_prompt:17:1222651016.text: Anyway, something happened to my boat, so it must be the criminal!
choice_prompt:17:1222651016.source_cn: 总之，我的船遭到这种事，肯定除了通缉犯没有别人！

say:18:1222651017:1.text: Besides a wanted criminal, what kind of person would mess with my boat?
say:18:1222651017:1.source_cn: 呃，除了通缉犯，不会有别人……吧。

say:19:1222651020:1.text: I-I mean, who else could it have been?
say:19:1222651020:1.source_cn: 总、总之，至少船绳子被割，肯定有凶手吧……

choice_prompt:20:1222651020.text: I-I mean, who else could it have been?
choice_prompt:20:1222651020.source_cn: 总、总之，至少船绳子被割，肯定有凶手吧……

say:21:1222651021:1.text: Don't be mad! I'm... Actually... I just thought maybe I'd give this bounty a shot since the rope was cut...
say:21:1222651021:1.source_cn: 别发火！我说实话！其实……是因为船的绳子被弄断了，我才...

choice:20:0:1.text: Did you see the criminal or not?!
choice:20:0:1.source_cn: 你到底有没有看到通缉犯本人！
choice:20:0:1.male: Did you see the criminal or not?!
choice:20:0:1.female: Did you see the criminal or not?!

say:24:1222651019:1.source_cn: 啊，呃，这个，这个，其实，那个……

say:25:1222651014:1.text: Uh... It could probably fit two or three people, I guess?
say:25:1222651014:1.source_cn: 我估摸着……载两三个人还是够的吧？

say:26:1222651015:1.text: "Guess"? You own the boat and don't even know how many people it can carry?
say:26:1222651015:1.source_cn: 你自己的船，你连到底能载多少人都不确定吗！

say:27:1222651011:1.text: Well... yeah, but maybe she was trying to throw people off, you know? Anyway.
say:27:1222651011:1.source_cn: 呃，那个，可能是，是要掩人耳目？所以，呃，那个，就……

choice:10:1:2.text: A little each day? That's odd.
choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 每天割断一点？这很奇怪
choice:10:1:2.male: A little each day? That's odd.
choice:10:1:2.female: A little each day? That's odd.

say:28:1222651007:1.text: How should I know? Maybe because it looked sturdy!
say:28:1222651007:1.source_cn: 我怎么知道！大概是因为我的船看上去很结实吧。

choice:7:1:2.text: Why would she want your boat?
choice:7:1:2.male: Why would she want your boat?
choice:7:1:2.female: Why would she want your boat?

say:3:1222652001:1.text: Come on, don't doubt me! I would never lie!
say:3:1222652001:1.source_cn: 哎呀~不要怀疑人家啦！人家是绝对不会说谎的哦。

say:4:1222652002:1.text: She's kinda cute for a criminal, even with her pale skin.
say:4:1222652002:1.source_cn: 那个通缉犯虽然有着惨白的皮肤，但长相还蛮可爱嘛。

say:6:1222652004:1.text: I go out of the city to pick flowers every day. This morning, I saw her near the woods, just outside the southern gate.
say:6:1222652004:1.source_cn: 人家每天都会出城采花，今天大清早，我在南门外的树林里看...

say:7:1222652005:1.text: Now, I'm not really interested in the bounty—too much work. But do you think Miss Sonja could stop by my flower shop sometime?
say:7:1222652005:1.source_cn: 人家不想要什么赏金，可不可以请索尼娅小姐来人家的花店坐坐呢？

say:8:1222652006:1.text: I mean, a little endorsement and good publicity wouldn't hurt, right?
say:8:1222652006:1.source_cn: 比起一时的利益，人家更想要能用来宣传的噱头嘛。

say:9:1222652007:1.text: Such an enthusiastic girl... and a sharp business sense too. She and Rowan would definitely get along.
say:9:1222652007:1.source_cn: 真是热情的女孩子……而且很有商业头脑，罗万和她肯定会有...

say:10:1222652008:1.text: How much more proof do you need? I really saw her with my own eyes.
say:10:1222652008:1.source_cn: 还要怎么确认嘛，人家真的亲眼看到了。

choice_prompt:11:1222652008.text: How much more proof do you need? I really saw her with my own eyes.
choice_prompt:11:1222652008.source_cn: 还要怎么确认嘛，人家真的亲眼看到了。

say:12:1222652009:1.text: Of course! Isn't there a sketch on the wanted poster?
say:12:1222652009:1.source_cn: 通缉令上不都画着……况且，我也亲眼看到了啦！

say:13:1222652011:1.text: I go to that forest often. The flowers there are beautiful, a lucky spot for sure.
say:13:1222652011:1.source_cn: 人家经常去那片树林，那里的花格外鲜艳，看来那里是个幸运...

choice_prompt:14:1222652011.text: I go to that forest often. The flowers there are beautiful, a lucky spot for sure.
choice_prompt:14:1222652011.source_cn: 人家经常去那片树林，那里的花格外鲜艳，看来那里是个幸运场所呢。

say:15:1222652012:1.text: W-well, you're not a florist, so you wouldn't know!
say:15:1222652012:1.source_cn: 这、这个，您不是卖花的人，不懂的啦！

say:16:1222652016:1.text: I saw her silhouette, and I was just about to get closer, but she disappeared in a flash!
say:16:1222652016:1.source_cn: 当时，我看见她的身影，正想走近一点，结果她立马就消失了！

choice_prompt:17:1222652016.text: I saw her silhouette, and I was just about to get closer, but she disappeared in a flash!
choice_prompt:17:1222652016.source_cn: 当时，我看见她的身影，正想走近一点，结果她立马就消失了！

say:18:1222652017:1.text: Oh, are you worried about me? Thanks! But I'm a brave girl, I wouldn't be scared of a Graveborn!
say:18:1222652017:1.source_cn: 咦？你在关心人家吗？谢谢！人家是个勇敢的女孩子，亡灵什...

say:20:1222652018:1.text: Like a bubble—poof! She was gone in an instant.
say:20:1222652018:1.source_cn: 像泡沫那样，噗！一下就没了呀。

say:21:1222652019:1.text: Hmm... that sounds a bit suspicious. Did you really see her?
say:21:1222652019:1.source_cn: 嗯……你真的看见了吗？听上去不太像真的。

choice_prompt:22:1222652019.text: Hmm... that sounds a bit suspicious. Did you really see her?
choice_prompt:22:1222652019.source_cn: 嗯……你真的看见了吗？听上去不太像真的。

say:23:1222652020:1.text: Jeez, no need to be so harsh! Sorry, I was lying, I just... really wanted to meet Sonja...
say:23:1222652020:1.source_cn: 哇呀！好凶哦……对不起嘛，人家只是想见见索尼娅小姐而已……

choice:22:0:1.text: Did you really see the criminal?!
choice:22:0:1.source_cn: 你到底有没有看见通缉犯？
choice:22:0:1.male: Did you really see the criminal?!
choice:22:0:1.female: Did you really see the criminal?!

choice:14:0:1.text: Is there really a place like that?
choice:14:0:1.source_cn: 我不记得树林里有花田
choice:14:0:1.male: Is there really a place like that?
choice:14:0:1.female: Is there really a place like that?

say:25:1222652014:1.text: What about when the weather's bad, like if it's storming?

say:26:1222652015:1.text: Uh, well... Let's not talk about exceptions like that...
say:26:1222652015:1.source_cn: 这种例外就不要提了吧……

choice:11:0:1.text: You're sure it was a girl?
choice:11:0:1.male: You're sure it was a girl?
choice:11:0:1.female: You're sure it was a girl?

say:27:1222652010:1.text: Yes, it was broad daylight. I was picking flowers and saw her clear as day.
say:27:1222652010:1.source_cn: 我采花的时候已经天亮了，看得很清楚呢。

say:2:1222653001:1.text: Don't judge me by my appearance! I'm long past my Water Wight days, I'm just an honest boatman now.
say:2:1222653001:1.source_cn: 别看我这样，我早就和水鬼帮说永别了，目前是个正经的船工。

say:3:1222653002:1.text: Well, except for the occasional black market deal... Anyway, this woman came up to me, acting all shady. She must've been up to something.
say:3:1222653002:1.source_cn: 我偶尔也会跟黑市做点生意，那天，有个女的来找我，她鬼鬼...

say:4:1222653003:1.text: She was dressed in rags, didn't look like she had much money, and she wanted to buy a boat. Asked me to pull some strings for her.
say:4:1222653003:1.source_cn: 她穿得很破，不像是有钱的样子，她想买船，托我给她找关系。

say:5:1222653004:1.text: But the timing was bad, both the authorities and the underworld were cracking down on boat sales.
say:5:1222653004:1.source_cn: 但我知道最近管得严，黑白两边都有人放话，禁止任何船只交易。

say:6:1222653005:1.text: I didn't make any money from her, but I figured I could at least report her and cash in on the bounty.
say:6:1222653005:1.source_cn: 没挣到那女人的钱，总得让我挣一笔血薇帮的赏金吧，所以我...

say:7:1222653006:1.text: Alright, I get the gist. But I need more details.
say:7:1222653006:1.source_cn: 大致情况我了解了，但是还得仔细问问清楚。

say:8:1222653007:1.text: I'm telling you, she has to be the wanted criminal!
say:8:1222653007:1.source_cn: 我敢确定，买船的那个女人绝对是通缉犯！

choice_prompt:9:1222653007.text: I'm telling you, she has to be the wanted criminal!
choice_prompt:9:1222653007.source_cn: 我敢确定，买船的那个女人绝对是通缉犯！

say:10:1222653008:1.text: Well, not exactly, people still buy boats...uh, I mean, you're right! Definitely!
say:10:1222653008:1.source_cn: 也不能这么说，不少人还是会买的……呃，我是说，你说得对...

say:11:1222653010:1.text: Her voice was all secretive and sly, she's definitely up to no good.
say:11:1222653010:1.source_cn: 那个女人说话的语气神秘兮兮，一看就是心怀不轨。

choice_prompt:12:1222653010.text: Her voice was all secretive and sly, she's definitely up to no good.
choice_prompt:12:1222653010.source_cn: 那个女人说话的语气神秘兮兮，一看就是心怀不轨。

say:13:1222653011:1.text: She was shorter than me, and her face...
say:13:1222653011:1.source_cn: 她比我矮一些，长相的话……

say:14:1222653012:1.text: Well, she was wearing a cloak. Couldn't see her face at all.
say:14:1222653012:1.source_cn: 呃……其实，她当时穿着斗篷，把脸遮得严严实实。

say:15:1222653015:1.text: Look, no matter how you slice it, she's gotta be the wanted criminal!
say:15:1222653015:1.source_cn: 你们看，这种人怎么想都只能是那个通缉犯！

choice_prompt:16:1222653015.text: Look, no matter how you slice it, she's gotta be the wanted criminal!
choice_prompt:16:1222653015.source_cn: 你们看，这种人怎么想都只能是那个通缉犯！

say:17:1222653016:1.text: Because every single thing about her perfectly matches the description on your wanted poster!
say:17:1222653016:1.source_cn: 因为每一条都对上了啊！跟你们通缉令的要求一样！

say:18:1222653018:1.text: At the very least, she's suspicious, right?

choice_prompt:19:1222653018.text: At the very least, she's suspicious, right?

say:20:1222653019:1.text: Enough already! I didn't get a clear look, okay? I just know it was a hooded woman!
say:20:1222653019:1.source_cn: 烦死了！我没看清！只知道是个戴兜帽的女人！

say:21:1222653020:1.text: It can't be anyone else but her, believe it or not!
say:21:1222653020:1.source_cn: 但是除了通缉犯也不可能是别人啊？你们爱信不信吧！

choice:19:0:1.text: So was it the criminal or not?!
choice:19:0:1.male: So was it the criminal or not?!
choice:19:0:1.female: So was it the criminal or not?!

say:23:1222653017:1.text: Uh... just, um, mysterious, slender, and female?
say:23:1222653017:1.source_cn: ……呃，就是，就是神秘的，一个，纤细的，女性？

choice:16:1:2.text: What does the criminal look like?
choice:16:1:2.male: What does the criminal look like?
choice:16:1:2.female: What does the criminal look like?

say:24:1222653013:1.text: She said she wanted to buy a boat. I asked where she was headed, but she wouldn't tell me.
say:24:1222653013:1.source_cn: 她说想买船出海，我问她打算去哪里，她不说。

say:25:1222653014:1.text: She also mentioned she didn't have much money and asked if there were any boats on the cheaper side.
say:25:1222653014:1.source_cn: 她还说自己手头不宽裕，能给的钱不多，想问问有没有便宜点的船。

choice:12:1:2.text: What did she say to you?
choice:12:1:2.male: What did she say to you?
choice:12:1:2.female: What did she say to you?

say:26:1222653009:1.text: Uh... evidence... isn't that important, right? She came to buy a boat, that's suspicious enough!
say:26:1222653009:1.source_cn: 呃，证据……证据不重要吧！都有人来买船了！

say:3:1222654001:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're quite good at interrogations. I almost want to learn a thing or two from you.
say:3:1222654001:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're quite good at interrogations. I almost want to learn a thing or two from you.
say:3:1222654001:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're quite good at interrogations. I almost want to learn a thing or two from you.

say:4:1222654002:0.text: Of course, Magister Merlin is good at many things, so you'd better ask humbly!
say:4:1222654002:0.source_cn: 梅林擅长的事多着呢，你可得虚心求教。
say:4:1222654002:0.male: Of course, Magister Merlin is good at many things, so you'd better ask humbly!
say:4:1222654002:0.female: Of course, Magister Merlin is good at many things, so you'd better ask humbly!

say:5:1222654003:1.text: Thanks to all of you, I understand what they're going on about.
say:5:1222654003:1.source_cn: 多亏了各位，我有些眉目了。

say:6:1222654004:0.text: Dante, the fisherman, just wants to figure out who's cutting his boat's rope.
say:6:1222654004:0.source_cn: 根据目前掌握的情报，渔民丹诺只想借机解决有人割他船绳的问题。

say:7:1222654005:1.text: The criminal is swift and decisive, she wouldn't waste time on something as trivial as that.
say:7:1222654005:1.source_cn: 对方是个干脆利落的杀手，不可能连割绳子这种小事都磨磨蹭蹭。

say:8:1222654006:1.text: Exactly. Dante's information isn't worth much.
say:8:1222654006:1.source_cn: 是的，所以我认为丹诺的情报不需要太在意。

say:9:1222654007:1.text: And the florist? She's just one of Sonja's many fans. She's desperate to meet her, so we can't rely on her claims either.
say:9:1222654007:1.source_cn: 至于那位卖花的姑娘，她是索尼娅的仰慕者，只是想见索尼娅...

say:10:1222654008:1.text: But that sailor, Gunnar, what he said was worth noting.
say:10:1222654008:1.source_cn: 而那个叫红锚的水手，他说的情报非常值得注意。

say:11:1222654009:1.text: Yeah! Even though he didn't see her face, anyone sneaking around trying to buy a boat is super suspicious!
say:11:1222654009:1.source_cn: 是啊，尽管他没见到买家的真容，但这时候偷偷摸摸买船的人...

say:12:1222654010:1.text: Let's send off the informants that are just stirring up trouble, then we'll have a proper conversation with Gunnar about the details.
say:12:1222654010:1.source_cn: 把那些浑水摸鱼的家伙打发走，再找红锚先生好好询问一些细节吧。

say:0:1222655001:0.text: But the bounty I was hopin' to get!

say:0:1222655101:0.text: I wanted to see Sonja up close, at least once in my life...

say:3:1222656001:1.text: C'mon, use your brains! Don't you agree that the person I met is really suspicious?
say:3:1222656001:1.source_cn: 你们不觉得那个人很可疑吗！你们动动脑子！

say:4:1222656002:1.text: I mean, I do want the bounty... but I wasn't lying! I'm just not sure if she's the criminal in the wanted poster.
say:4:1222656002:1.source_cn: 我确实很想要赏金……但我没撒谎啊！我只是不确定她究竟是...

say:5:1222656003:1.text: Don't worry, Gunnar! We believe you. That's why we want to ask more about your conversation with that buyer.
say:5:1222656003:1.source_cn: 别慌张，红锚先生，我们相信你说的话，所以才想问问你和那...

say:6:1222656004:1.text: Ugh, haven't I already explained it all?! Can you hamsters understand human speech or not?
say:6:1222656004:1.source_cn: 我刚才不都说清楚了吗！你这耗子能不能听懂人话？

say:7:1222656005:1.text: How dare you insult Magister Merlin's familiars! If you want that bounty, you'd better watch your attitude!
say:7:1222656005:1.source_cn: 不得对梅林的使魔无礼！想拿走赏金，最好注意你的态度！
say:7:1222656005:1.male: How dare you insult Magister Merlin's familiars! If you want that bounty, you'd better watch your attitude!
say:7:1222656005:1.female: How dare you insult Magister Merlin's familiars! If you want that bounty, you'd better watch your attitude!

say:9:1222656007:1.text: To be honest, I think... the hooded figure wasn't a Graveborn, but a human.
say:9:1222656007:1.source_cn: 实话实话，我觉得……那个戴兜帽的人不是亡灵，而是人类。

choice_prompt:10:1222656007.text: To be honest, I think... the hooded figure wasn't a Graveborn, but a human.
choice_prompt:10:1222656007.source_cn: 实话实话，我觉得……那个戴兜帽的人不是亡灵，而是人类。

say:11:1222656008:1.text: Look, during my time with the Wights, I got to know the Graveborn pretty well.
say:11:1222656008:1.source_cn: 我在水鬼帮混过一阵子，很了解亡灵。

say:12:1222656009:1.text: That woman wasn't like them. If she's able to breathe, that means she's alive, right?
say:12:1222656009:1.source_cn: 那女人和亡灵不一样，我觉得她有呼吸。有呼吸的就是活人，对吧。

say:15:1222656011:1.text: Still, even if she's human, she's suspicious.
say:15:1222656011:1.source_cn: 不过，就算是人类，这个买家也很可疑。

say:16:1222656012:1.text: Do you know how to get in touch with her?

say:17:1222656013:1.text: Of course, I didn't outright reject the deal. A man's gotta make money somehow. If the Whispers didn't pay me, I would've had to go through with that sale.
say:17:1222656013:1.source_cn: 当然能，我本来也没明着拒绝这笔买卖，要是血薇帮不给我赏...

say:18:1222656014:1.text: Go ahead, take her order and set up a date for the boat exchange. We'll lay an ambush.
say:18:1222656014:1.source_cn: 那么，你接下她的订单，约个交船的日子，我们会暗中埋伏。

say:19:1222656015:1.text: Sounds like a lotta trouble for me, I'm gonna have to ask for more money than that bounty.

say:20:1222656016:1.text: As long as you do what we say, you'll be well compensated. The Carmine Whispers never shorts its people.
say:20:1222656016:1.source_cn: 只要你按照我们说的做，你会得到满意的数额，血薇帮从不亏...

say:21:1222656017:1.text: Hmph... fine, I'll trust you for now. I'll contact you when it's set up.
say:21:1222656017:1.source_cn: 哼……姑且信你们一次，等我消息吧。

say:23:1222656010:1.text: I've seen plenty of Graveborn in my time with the Wights, and this woman didn't smell like rot.
say:23:1222656010:1.source_cn: 亡灵那东西，我在水鬼帮的时候见多了，那女人身上味道和亡...

narration:0:1222657001:0.text: After several days of waiting, on the day of the transaction...
narration:0:1222657001:0.source_cn: 又等候了数日，直到约定交船日当天……

say:3:1222657002:1.text: Today's the day Gunnar's meeting up with the lady. Let's head over.
say:3:1222657002:1.source_cn: 今天是红锚约好的交易时间，出发吧，去交易现场。

say:4:1222657003:1.text: I've already spoken to the guards at the dock. They'll be keeping an eye out to ensure nothing goes wrong.
say:4:1222657003:1.source_cn: 我跟码头的警卫打过招呼了，他们也会暗中在盯着，确保万无一失。

say:5:1222657004:1.text: Oh, I remember that guard. He's super diligent, I'm sure everything will be fine with him here!
say:5:1222657004:1.source_cn: 是那个很敬业的警卫先生，有他在就更安稳了！

say:6:1222657005:1.source_cn: 事不宜迟，我们赶紧过去吧！

say:0:1222658001:0.text: Look! There's someone talking to Gunnar!
say:0:1222658001:0.source_cn: 看！有个人在和红锚说话。

say:1:1222658002:0.text: The bait is set... Let's be careful not to get spotted.
say:1:1222658002:0.source_cn: 鱼上钩了，我们小心点，不能被发现。

say:4:1222659002:1.text: You said there weren't any boats available last time, now there suddenly is?
say:4:1222659002:1.source_cn: 你上次说没货，现在有了？

say:5:1222659003:1.text: You want a ship that can sail far, but a ship like that usually needs sailors and supplies. It ain't easy getting a hold of all that.
say:5:1222659003:1.source_cn: 你想要能远航的大船，这种船啊，一般都得配上水手和物资，...

say:6:1222659004:1.text: I don't need sailors or supplies. Just the ship.
say:6:1222659004:1.source_cn: 水手和物资，我都用不上，我只要船。

say:7:1222659005:1.text: Alright, well, you're in luck. One of my clients went broke, and his merchant ship's up for grabs. It could be yours.
say:7:1222659005:1.source_cn: 好吧，你很幸运，我有个客户的资金链断了，他拿自己做生意...

say:9:1222659007:1.text: Hold on, we haven't even discussed the terms yet. Let's talk it over...
say:9:1222659007:1.source_cn: 别急啊……买卖条款的具体事项都还没聊好呢，你听我慢慢说啊——

say:8:1222660003:1.text: We could ask you the same thing!

say:10:1222660005:1.text: Not talking, huh? You must know who I am. Hiding things from me won't end well for you.
say:10:1222660005:1.source_cn: 不说吗？你应该知道我是谁，瞒着我，可能不会有什么好下场。

say:11:1222660006:0.text: ... My name is Nalianne. I'm a repairwoman, I usually fix fishing boat sails.
say:11:1222660006:0.source_cn: ……我叫纳莉安，是个修理工，经常帮渔船修补船帆。

say:12:1222660007:0.text: Well then, you seem like an honest worker. Why are you trying to break the rules, then?
say:12:1222660007:0.source_cn: 那么，纳莉安小姐，你是个本分的工人，为什么要违背禁令呢？

say:15:1222660008:0.text: I... had no choice. I got a letter from my brother. He's gravely ill and wanted to see me one last time.
say:15:1222660008:0.source_cn: 我……我走投无路了。我收到弟弟的信，他说自己得了重病，...

say:16:1222660009:0.text: But the Carmine Whispers issued a blockade, banning all ships from leaving the port. I was desperate...
say:16:1222660009:0.source_cn: 但是血薇帮下了封锁令，不许船只出港，我没有办法，又很着急……

say:17:1222660010:0.text: I see. You must be very close to your brother, Miss Nalianne! After all, it's no small feat to earn enough for a ship and hire sailors.
say:17:1222660010:0.source_cn: 这样啊，纳莉安小姐和弟弟的感情一定很深，毕竟一整艘船和...

say:18:1222660011:0.text: Hmph, that gamblin—I mean, yes, we're very close. I'd do anything for him.
say:18:1222660011:0.source_cn: 哼，那个赌鬼……不，我是说，我们感情确实很好，所以花再...

say:19:1222660012:1.text: Though ships are banned from leaving, you can apply for a special permit with a legitimate reason.
say:19:1222660012:1.source_cn: 虽然封锁了船只进出，但只要有正当理由，提出申请后，就能...

say:20:1222660013:1.text: It usually doesn't take more than a day for a permit to get processed.
say:20:1222660013:1.source_cn: 审核的批复效率很高，最多不超过一天。

say:21:1222660014:1.text: How about this? I'll give you a fast-track certificate. Submit your application now, and you'll have it by the end of the day.
say:21:1222660014:1.source_cn: 这样吧，我给你开个加急证明，你现在去提交申请，今天之内...

say:22:1222660015:1.source_cn: 哎？你们这是要……要放我走？

say:23:1222660016:1.text: Of course, your reasoning is understandable. The Whispers don't mess with decent folk.
say:23:1222660016:1.source_cn: 当然，你的违规情有可原。血薇帮不会为难善良的居民。

say:24:1222660017:0.text: You've been through enough, there's no need to waste your hard-earned money on illegal deals. Just go get a legal permit.
say:24:1222660017:0.source_cn: 你也不容易，没必要把血汗钱浪费在违法交易，去拿正规的离...

say:26:1222660019:0.text: What's the matter? You save money and get to see your brother. Aren't you happy?
say:26:1222660019:0.source_cn: 怎么了？又能省下钱，又能见到弟弟，你不开心吗？

say:27:1222660020:0.text: If all goes well, you might even be able to leave tomorrow.
say:27:1222660020:0.source_cn: 顺利的话，明天说不定就能离港出去了哦？

say:28:1222660021:0.text: ... I'm just very moved. Thank you, I'll go submit my application right away.
say:28:1222660021:0.source_cn: ……我只是太感动了。谢谢你们，我马上去写申请。

narration:32:1222660022:0.text: Nalianne bows deeply and walks away, still looking a bit confused.
narration:32:1222660022:0.source_cn: 纳莉安深深地鞠躬道谢，面带疑惑地走远了

say:33:1222660023:0.text: Hey, you're letting her go just like that? She's so suspicious!
say:33:1222660023:0.source_cn: 到底在搞什么……不是，你们这就放她走了？她很可疑啊！

choice_prompt:34:1222660023.text: Hey, you're letting her go just like that? She's so suspicious!
choice_prompt:34:1222660023.source_cn: 到底在搞什么……不是，你们这就放她走了？她很可疑啊！

say:35:1222660024:0.text: Gunnar, we're not as clueless as you think. Vayne! Come here.
say:35:1222660024:0.source_cn: 红锚，我们没你想得那么蠢。瓦因！过来。

say:38:1222660025:0.text: Boss, what can I do for you?

say:39:1222660026:0.text: Follow that woman, but keep your distance. Don't let her know you're there. Report everything she does to me.
say:39:1222660026:0.source_cn: 你远远地跟上那个女人，不要打草惊蛇，把她之后的行动都汇...

say:43:1222660028:0.text: And you, Gunnar, go find Grayfang. I know you two are close.
say:43:1222660028:0.source_cn: 至于你，红锚，你现在去找灰舌，我知道你们很熟。

say:44:1222660029:0.text: Give him a message: if that woman comes to buy a boat, sell one to her.
say:44:1222660029:0.source_cn: 你给灰舌带个话，如果那女人找灰舌买船，记住，卖给她。

say:45:1222660030:0.text: Earning money from you guys takes way too much effort.
say:45:1222660030:0.source_cn: 真麻烦……想从你们手上挣点钱也太不容易了。

say:46:1222660031:0.text: You can back out if you want, but I can't promise when you'll see any reward.
say:46:1222660031:0.source_cn: 你现在退出也可以，但我不保证赏金什么时候才能到你手中。

say:47:1222660032:0.source_cn: 知道了！我照做还不行吗？

say:51:1222660034:0.text: Is Miss Nalianne really a bad person?

say:52:1222660035:0.text: We've pointed her in the right direction. If she's being honest, she'll take me up on my offer.
say:52:1222660035:0.source_cn: 我们已经为她指明了道路，要是她没骗我们，现在也知道该怎...

say:53:1222660036:0.text: But if she buys a boat illegally or contacts anyone suspicious...
say:53:1222660036:0.source_cn: 如果她还是选择私自买船，甚至和其他可疑的人接触……

say:54:1222660037:0.text: Then we'll have our target in our sights!
say:54:1222660037:0.source_cn: 那我们就抓到亡灵杀手的尾巴了！

choice:34:1:2.text: She'll lead us to a bigger catch.
choice:34:1:2.male: She'll lead us to a bigger catch.
choice:34:1:2.female: She'll lead us to a bigger catch.

narration:56:12602512:0.text: While Gunnar is dealing with the mysterious buyer, Lucca and you quickly move in to surround them.
narration:56:12602512:0.source_cn: 趁着水手“红锚”和神秘买家接头，你们和卢卡迅速上前围住他们。

say:0:1222661001:0.text: There are too many eyes here. Let's head back and leave the rest to Vayne.
say:0:1222661001:0.source_cn: 人多眼杂，先回去吧，剩下的就交给瓦因。

narration:2:1222662001:0.text: A few hours later, Vayne returns to report to Lucca.
narration:2:1222662001:0.source_cn: 数小时后，瓦因匆匆归来，向卢卡汇报——

say:3:1222662002:0.text: So, I followed the lady, and there's a lot to say. But I'll be quick.
say:3:1222662002:0.source_cn: 跟踪纳莉安的这一路有了大收获！各位，我长话短说。

say:4:1222662003:0.text: After she left you guys, she didn't go home. She just wandered around and talked to some sketchy people.
say:4:1222662003:0.source_cn: 我们放走她后，她没有回家，又去到处瞎转悠，接触那些贩子。

say:5:1222662004:0.text: Huh? So she really is up to no good!
say:5:1222662004:0.source_cn: 哎？所以她真的是坏人啊！

say:7:1222662006:0.text: At first, nobody wanted to sell her a boat, but then Gunnar told Grayfang about her, and I saw Grayfang himself go up to her with a deal.
say:7:1222662006:0.source_cn: 一开始没人卖她船，但等红锚传了消息，我看灰舌亲自去找她...

say:8:1222662007:0.text: After they made the deal, she tried to walk all around the city to lose anyone following her. But she couldn't lose me!
say:8:1222662007:0.source_cn: 等交易定下来，她故意在城里兜了几圈，像是要甩掉跟踪者—...

say:10:1222662009:0.text: Brineville? That's Sinbad's home. What's she doing there?
say:10:1222662009:0.source_cn: 小水村！那是辛巴达的家，她去那里干什么？

say:11:1222662010:0.text: She went into an old, spooky house. When I peeked through the window, I saw a Graveborn hiding inside!
say:11:1222662010:0.source_cn: 她进了一间没人住的破屋子，我趴在窗口，看见那屋子里竟然...

say:12:1222662011:0.text: It was the exact same one from the wanted posters.
say:12:1222662011:0.source_cn: 那亡灵跟通缉令上长得一模一样！

say:13:1222662012:0.text: I also heard bits of their talk...
say:13:1222662012:0.source_cn: 然后，我听到了她们的对话……

say:19:1222662013:0.text: The ship's ready. It can get you out of Rustport, though it might not reach your final destination.
say:19:1222662013:0.source_cn: 已经找到船了，他们可以送您离开锈锚港，但恐怕没法直接抵...

say:20:1222662014:0.text: That's fine. I wasn't planning on heading straight back.
say:20:1222662014:0.source_cn: 可以，我也没打算直接回去。

say:21:1222662015:0.text: We'll need to head to the dock tonight under the cover of the clouds. And don't worry, if anything goes wrong, I'll take the blame!
say:21:1222662015:0.source_cn: 那今晚得去小水湾的渡口，我陪着您。到时您直接上船，万一...

say:22:1222662016:1.text: ... You don't need to go that far.

say:23:1222662017:1.text: I'm an enemy of the Carmine Whispers, and a Graveborn at that. You're just an ordinary person...
say:23:1222662017:1.source_cn: 我是血薇帮的敌人，还是亡灵。而你只是个普通人……

say:25:1222662019:1.text: If it weren't for you, my gambling brother would've killed me for money long ago!
say:25:1222662019:1.source_cn: 如果不是您救了我，我弟弟那个赌鬼早为了钱，把我弄死了！
