say:26:1222662020:1.text: Compared to that, this bit of effort is nothing!
say:26:1222662020:1.source_cn: 我为您做的这点小事，根本不足以报答您的救命之恩！

say:28:1222662022:0.text: You don't need to thank me... It's just that the thought of leaving you... I'm suddenly getting quite sad.
say:28:1222662022:0.source_cn: 您无需感谢……只是，我想到要离开您，真的有些舍不得……

say:36:1222662024:1.text: I accidentally bumped into the wall and made the tiniest bit of noise, and she instantly got suspicious.
say:36:1222662024:1.source_cn: ——事情的经过就是这样。我只是不小心擦了下墙边，她立刻...

say:37:1222662025:1.text: Luckily, a rat scurried by, so I escaped her notice!
say:37:1222662025:1.source_cn: 我从没见过那么敏锐的人……幸好当时有只老鼠贴着墙根溜过...

say:39:1222662027:1.text: Excellent work, kiddo! You've provided us with crucial intel.
say:39:1222662027:1.source_cn: 辛苦了！你做得非常好，这可是重大情报！

say:40:1222662028:1.text: Since they're on the move tonight, we need to find Sonja and make a plan.
say:40:1222662028:1.source_cn: 既然她们今晚就要行动，我们现在就去找索尼娅商量对策。

say:2:1222663001:1.text: Sonja, could I enlist some of the Whispers girls for tonight's operation?
say:2:1222663001:1.source_cn: 索尼娅，咱们血薇帮的姑娘，能暂时拨给我调遣吗？

say:3:1222663002:1.text: Oh? You've made progress, I see. Planning to capture that assassin tonight?
say:3:1222663002:1.source_cn: 哦？看来事情有进展了。所以，你是打算今晚去抓捕那个杀手了？

say:4:1222663003:1.text: Just as we suspected, the Graveborn assassin does have a weakness.
say:4:1222663003:1.source_cn: 和我们先前的推测一样，那位亡灵杀手的确有软肋。

say:5:1222663004:1.text: Our spy reports she even went out of her way to shield a human woman in danger. A woman named Nalianne.
say:5:1222663004:1.source_cn: 据探子来报，她甚至出手保护了陷入危险的人类女性——也就...

say:6:1222663005:0.text: Nalianne is helping her to repay a life debt.
say:6:1222663005:0.source_cn: 纳莉安帮助她，是为了报答救命之恩。

say:7:1222663006:0.text: A life debt... This merciless assassin seems to have a soft spot for women.
say:7:1222663006:0.source_cn: 救命之恩……这位冷酷无情的杀手小姐对女性很心软，令人意外。

say:8:1222663007:1.text: Perhaps there was someone very important to her before she became a Graveborn...
say:8:1222663007:1.source_cn: 也许，在她那谈不上生命的生命里，曾经有过一位很重要的女...

choice_prompt:9:1222663007.text: Perhaps there was someone very important to her before she became a Graveborn...
choice_prompt:9:1222663007.source_cn: 也许，在她那谈不上生命的生命里，曾经有过一位很重要的女性吧……

say:10:1222663008:1.text: No... I know what I must do.
say:10:1222663008:1.source_cn: 不……我知道自己现在该做什么。

say:11:1222663010:1.text: Our top priority is to retrieve the Void Relic. That's our main focus.
say:11:1222663010:1.source_cn: 我们要尽快回收班题斯圣器，这才是重中之重。

say:12:1222663011:1.text: Since the assassin shows leniency towards women, whether out of compassion or a quirk, we should use that to our advantage.
say:12:1222663011:1.source_cn: 既然那个杀手会对女性网开一面，同情也好，怪癖也罢，我们...

say:13:1222663012:1.text: Lucca, you're in charge of tonight's operation. We're relying on you.
say:13:1222663012:1.source_cn: 卢卡，今晚的行动归你全权指挥，期待你的战果。

say:0:1222664001:0.text: Everything's in place. We'll wait at Brineville.
say:0:1222664001:0.source_cn: 都安排好了，我们去小水村那边埋伏起来吧。

say:3:1222665001:1.text: All preparations are complete. How are you feeling?
say:3:1222665001:1.source_cn: 各个环节都准备完毕了，各位，你们感觉怎么样？

choice_prompt:4:1222665001.text: All preparations are complete. How are you feeling?
choice_prompt:4:1222665001.source_cn: 各个环节都准备完毕了，各位，你们感觉怎么样？

say:5:1222665002:1.text: This vantage point keeps us hidden, it's perfect!
say:5:1222665002:1.source_cn: 嗯，这个角度不容易被发现，行动也很方便，非常完美！

say:6:1222665003:1.text: If the assassin dares to show, she'll have no way out!
say:6:1222665003:1.source_cn: 只要那个亡灵杀手敢来，绝对让她有来无回！

say:7:1222665006:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈！不错，轻松的心态非常重要。

say:8:1222665007:1.text: Graveborn normally act at night. Let's stay patient and wait.
say:8:1222665007:1.source_cn: 亡灵喜欢趁着夜晚行动，接下来，让我们耐心等待吧。

say:10:1222665004:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, did you not sleep well last night?
say:10:1222665004:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, did you not sleep well last night?
say:10:1222665004:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, did you not sleep well last night?

say:11:1222665005:1.text: Don't worry, we're here for you!
say:11:1222665005:1.male: Don't worry, we're here for you!
say:11:1222665005:1.female: Don't worry, we're here for you!

say:4:1222668002:1.source_cn: 血薇帮，你们别乱动，否则我会杀了她。

say:5:1222668003:1.text: Do it. She betrayed Rustport by siding with you. You'll actually be doing us a favor.
say:5:1222668003:1.source_cn: 动手吧，她替你做事，已经背叛了锈锚港。你愿意帮忙，我们...

say:7:1222668005:1.text: I'm not afraid! My life was yours anyway. Just take it now!
say:7:1222668005:1.source_cn: 我不怕！我这条命本来就是你给的，你可以拿走！

say:8:1222668006:1.text: Fool...! You're giving them more leverage with your words!
say:8:1222668006:1.source_cn: 笨蛋……！你的话会成为他们的把柄！

choice_prompt:9:1222668006.text: Fool...! You're giving them more leverage with your words!
choice_prompt:9:1222668006.source_cn: 笨蛋……！你的话会成为他们的把柄！

say:14:1222668010:1.text: Heh, we finally caught you! You really gave Lucca a hard time, he was so hurt.
say:14:1222668010:1.source_cn: 哼哼……总算抓到你了，当时你对卢卡下手那么重——

say:15:1222668011:1.text: I can hit a tiny hamster like you even harder.

say:16:1222668012:1.text: Eek! What a terrifying aura! Someone protect Chippy!

say:19:1222668013:1.text: Tie both of them up and take them back to Rustport. Sonja will handle the interrogation... personally.
say:19:1222668013:1.source_cn: 把她们两个都捆起来送回锈锚港，索尼娅会亲自审问。

say:21:1222668015:1.text: Release Nalianne and I won't resist.
say:21:1222668015:1.source_cn: 你们放了纳莉安，我不会抵抗。

say:22:1222668016:1.text: That's up to Sonja. You know we're not just targeting you because of the scars you gave me.
say:22:1222668016:1.source_cn: 这要等索尼娅的决断。你也知道，我们追捕你，不是因为你给...

say:23:1222668017:1.text: Let's move. Behave, and we'll treat her with respect.
say:23:1222668017:1.source_cn: 走吧，你老实一点，我们也会对她客气些。

say:24:1222668018:1.text: No... no!! Please don't take her! She's a good person! Let me go!
say:24:1222668018:1.source_cn: 不……不不不！求求你们别带走她！她是好人！你们放开我！

say:28:1222668020:1.source_cn: 西尔维娜？那是你的名字吗？

say:0:1222669001:0.text: We've finally captured the mastermind. Let's head back and report to Sonja.
say:0:1222669001:0.source_cn: 总算抓住罪魁祸首了，回去找索尼娅汇报吧。

say:2:1222670001:1.text: We've detained Nalianne and locked the assassin up in the high-security cell.
say:2:1222670001:1.source_cn: ……事情就是这样，纳莉安我们暂时羁押起来，而西尔维娜被...

say:3:1222670002:1.text: And we found this on the assassin.
say:3:1222670002:1.source_cn: 以及，我们从她身上找到了这个……

say:5:1222670003:1.text: The Void Relic, just like we thought. After all this trouble, it's finally in our hands.
say:5:1222670003:1.source_cn: ……果然是班题斯圣器。兜兜转转，总算回到了我们的手上。

say:6:1222670004:0.text: Good. Now, bring in the assassin. I'll handle her interrogation.
say:6:1222670004:0.source_cn: 很好，现在把那个亡灵杀手带来，我要亲自审讯她。

say:11:1222670006:1.text: ... I can walk on my own.

say:12:1222670007:1.text: You're Silvina? What's your connection to the Dead Tide Fleet? And why steal the Void Relic?
say:12:1222670007:1.source_cn: 你就是西尔维娜？你与死潮舰队是什么关系？为什么要抢夺班...

say:15:1222670010:1.text: Let Nalianne go, and I'll talk.
say:15:1222670010:1.source_cn: 先放了纳莉安，该说的我会说。

say:16:1222670011:0.text: Fine. Vayne, go send word and tell them to release Nalianne.
say:16:1222670011:0.source_cn: 可以。瓦因，你去传话，拿我的手令去把纳莉安放了。

say:18:1222670012:0.text: You should know how the Whispers operate. We never go back on our word.
say:18:1222670012:0.source_cn: 我们血薇帮的行事你应该也清楚，我不会出尔反尔，说放人就...

say:20:1222670014:1.text: I'm from the Bantus Empire. I serve the king. Silencing, assassination, covert killings—that's my job.
say:20:1222670014:1.source_cn: 我来自班题斯帝国，为骸骨之王效力。主要工作是封口、行刺...

say:22:1222670015:1.text: Is there a difference between those?
say:22:1222670015:1.source_cn: 这三件事有什么差别吗？

say:23:1222670016:1.source_cn: 从专业角度来说，差异很大。

say:24:1222670017:1.text: Alright then... You came to Rustport for the Void Relic, didn't you?
say:24:1222670017:1.source_cn: 好吧……西尔维娜小姐，你来到锈锚港，是为了班题斯圣器吗？

say:25:1222670018:1.text: For the king. I came to retrieve what's his.
say:25:1222670018:1.source_cn: 我接受骸骨之王的命令，前来回收属于他的班题斯圣器。

say:26:1222670019:1.source_cn: 但我的任务已经失败，到此为止了。

say:28:1222670020:1.text: You failed to get the relic. Your king won't just let it go, will he?
say:28:1222670020:1.source_cn: ……圣器没能回收，骸骨之王不会就这样善罢甘休？

say:30:1222670022:0.text: Once they hear about my failure, the Empire will send more assassins. They'll finish the job.
say:30:1222670022:0.source_cn: 等我失败的消息传回帝国，会有第二批精英杀手来到锈锚港，...

say:31:1222670023:0.text: I see. Take her back to the cell.
say:31:1222670023:0.source_cn: 我知道了。来人，带她回牢房。

narration:35:1222670024:0.text: After Silvina is led away, Sonja stands there, thinking...
narration:35:1222670024:0.source_cn: 西尔维娜被带走后，索尼娅陷入沉思——

say:36:1222670025:0.text: From what she said, the Bantus Empire will keep coming after the relic.
say:36:1222670025:0.source_cn: 索尼娅，听她的意思，班题斯帝国还会派人来锈锚港抢夺圣器。

say:37:1222670026:0.text: As long as we have it, the fighting won't stop...
say:37:1222670026:0.source_cn: 只要留着圣器，锈锚港的纷争将会没完没了……

say:38:1222670027:1.text: Is the relic even useful to the Carmine Whispers?
say:38:1222670027:1.source_cn: 圣器对血薇帮来说有什么用吗？

say:41:1222670028:1.text: No, but we're more worried about it falling into the hands of people like the Dead Tide Fleet.
say:41:1222670028:1.source_cn: 没用，但我们担心圣器回到死潮舰队手中。

say:42:1222670029:1.text: Maybe... we could just give it to Silvina.
say:42:1222670029:1.source_cn: 或许……交给西尔维娜也是一种选择。

say:43:1222670030:1.text: If you don't let her go, what are you planning to do with her?
say:43:1222670030:1.source_cn: 如果不放走她，你们打算怎么处置她呢？

say:44:1222670031:0.text: I haven't decided yet. I need more time to think.
say:44:1222670031:0.source_cn: 我还没想好，请再给我一些时间。

say:0:1222671001:0.text: Let's all rest for now while she continues thinking on this.
say:0:1222671001:0.source_cn: 索尼娅还要再考虑一阵子，你们先休息吧。

say:1:1222671002:0.text: I'll let you know if there's any news.
say:1:1222671002:0.source_cn: 有消息我会随时通知各位。

say:0:1222672001:0.text: I wonder what her decision will be.
say:0:1222672001:0.source_cn: 不知道索尼娅会怎么处理。

say:1:1222672002:0.text: Well, it's her call. Let's get some rest at the inn.
say:1:1222672002:0.source_cn: 让她自己决断吧。我们先回客金旅店休息。
say:1:1222672002:0.male: Well, it's her call. Let's get some rest at the inn.
say:1:1222672002:0.female: Well, it's her call. Let's get some rest at the inn.

say:0:1222673001:0.text: We've been tailing people every night, Chippy's exhausted!
say:0:1222673001:0.source_cn: 这几天晚上都在外头跟踪，累死满满了！

narration:0:1222674001:0.text: After a long, comfortable rest, the next morning...
narration:0:1222674001:0.source_cn: 舒舒服服地睡了一觉，第二天早上……

say:3:1222674002:0.text: That was the best sleep Chippy's had in ages!
say:3:1222674002:0.source_cn: 睡得好饱！很久没有好好休息过了！

say:4:1222674003:0.text: We've been running around for days, chasing after Bonnie, then Silvina...
say:4:1222674003:0.source_cn: 这些天又是抓波妮，又是抓西尔维娜，天天晚上追踪埋伏，昼...

say:5:1222674004:0.text: But Sonja probably didn't sleep at all last night...
say:5:1222674004:0.source_cn: 不过，索尼娅昨晚上大概一宿没睡。

choice_prompt:6:1222674004.text: But Sonja probably didn't sleep at all last night...
choice_prompt:6:1222674004.source_cn: 不过，索尼娅昨晚上大概一宿没睡。

say:7:1222674005:0.text: Yes, that relic that can control the Graveborn.
say:7:1222674005:0.source_cn: 是啊，那可是能控制亡灵的圣器。

say:8:1222674006:0.text: Even if Sonja can't use it, keeping the relic might give her leverage with the king of Bantus. On the other hand, if she destroys it, she could stop tragedies like Nara's from happening again. It's a tough one...
say:8:1222674006:0.source_cn: 就算用不上，留在手里，说不定能与骸骨之王交换利益；要是...

say:9:1222674009:0.text: Well, we've had a proper rest. Should we go see Sonja now?
say:9:1222674009:0.source_cn: 我们休息好了，要不要去看看索尼娅看看？

say:10:1222674010:0.text: If she's still feeling conflicted, maybe the great Magister Merlin can help her out!
say:10:1222674010:0.source_cn: 如果她还在纠结，伟大的魔法师梅林也能帮她权衡利弊嘛！
say:10:1222674010:0.male: If she's still feeling conflicted, maybe the great Magister Merlin can help her out!
say:10:1222674010:0.female: If she's still feeling conflicted, maybe the great Magister Merlin can help her out!

say:11:1222674011:0.text: Yes! Sonja might need your help right now. Let's go!
say:11:1222674011:0.source_cn: 没错，索尼娅这时候可能正需要主人呢！主人，我们走吧。
say:11:1222674011:0.male: Yes! Sonja might need your help right now. Let's go!
say:11:1222674011:0.female: Yes! Sonja might need your help right now. Let's go!

say:13:1222674007:0.text: But is Silvina really as cold-hearted as she looks?
say:13:1222674007:0.source_cn: 那位西尔维娜小姐，她真的是一位冷酷无情的女性吗？

say:14:1222674008:0.text: Do you think seeing her will remind Sonja of Nara again?
say:14:1222674008:0.source_cn: 看到她的时候，不知道索尼娅会不会再次想起奈拉。

say:3:1222675001:0.text: I knew you'd come. How was your rest?
say:3:1222675001:0.source_cn: 你们果然来店里了。昨晚休息得如何？

say:4:1222675002:1.text: Great! How's Sonja? Has she come to a decision yet?
say:4:1222675002:1.source_cn: 很好！索尼娅呢？她怎么样了？

say:5:1222675003:1.text: I think she's made up her mind, but she hasn't shared the details with me yet.
say:5:1222675003:1.source_cn: 我感觉她下定了决心，但她没有告诉我具体的打算。

say:6:1222675004:1.text: Still, she did ask me to wait here for you.
say:6:1222675004:1.source_cn: 不过，是她让我在这里等你们的。

say:7:1222675005:1.text: She said that she wanted you to meet her at the docks.
say:7:1222675005:1.male: She said that she wanted you to meet her at the docks.
say:7:1222675005:1.female: She said that she wanted you to meet her at the docks.

say:8:1222675006:1.text: The docks, huh? She's probably going to announce her decision. Always so decisive, that's why I admire her!
say:8:1222675006:1.source_cn: 港口……大概是要当着我们的面宣布吧，她还是这么有主见。

say:9:1222675007:1.text: What do you think Sonja's going to do with the relic? Magister, Chippy is sooo curious! Let's go, let's go!
say:9:1222675007:1.source_cn: 索尼娅到底打算怎么处置亡灵圣器呢？主人，我们快去港口吧！
say:9:1222675007:1.male: What do you think Sonja's going to do with the relic? Magister, Chippy is sooo curious! Let's go, let's go!
say:9:1222675007:1.female: What do you think Sonja's going to do with the relic? Magister, Chippy is sooo curious! Let's go, let's go!

say:0:1222676001:0.text: Why meet at the docks, though?
say:0:1222676001:0.source_cn: 索尼娅为什么要专门约在港口见面呢？

say:1:1222676002:0.text: Not sure, but she's got her reasons, no doubt.
say:1:1222676002:0.source_cn: 嗯，我也不知道她有什么打算，但肯定事出有因。

say:3:1222678001:1.text: Sorry to have kept you waiting.

choice_prompt:4:1222678001.text: Sorry to have kept you waiting.

say:5:1222678002:1.text: I'm choosing to trust Silvina—but that doesn't mean I'm handing Rustport's fate to her entirely.
say:5:1222678002:1.source_cn: 暂时相信西尔维娜吧——话虽如此，我也不可能把锈锚港的命...

say:8:1222678005:1.text: Look. This is the result of all our efforts these past few days.
say:8:1222678005:1.source_cn: 请看，这便是我们奔波数日的收获。

say:9:1222678006:1.text: I think I've found the best place for it.
say:9:1222678006:1.source_cn: 我想，我已经帮它找到了最好的归宿。

say:10:1222678007:0.text: When you continue your journey, I'd like you to take it with you.
say:10:1222678007:0.source_cn: 当你们再度踏上旅程时，请带上它吧。

say:12:1222678008:1.text: Sonja, are you really giving the relic to Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>?!
say:12:1222678008:1.male: Sonja, are you really giving the relic to Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>?!
say:12:1222678008:1.female: Sonja, are you really giving the relic to Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>?!

say:14:1222678010:1.text: You've seen the atrocities Hodgkin committed with it. This relic would be too dangerous in the hands of a Graveborn. I even considered burying it, ensuring no one ever finds it.
say:14:1222678010:1.source_cn: 我不想将它交给亡灵。我也想过干脆把它埋藏起来，让它永远...

say:15:1222678011:1.text: But no matter what, it's a relic that the Empire wants, and many others will chase after it.
say:15:1222678011:1.source_cn: 但是，再怎么说，它是被亡灵们视为至宝的圣器，觊觎它的人...

say:16:1222678012:1.text: In the right hands, maybe it could serve a better purpose.
say:16:1222678012:1.source_cn: 如果它在可靠的人手中，说不定能发挥出更正当的用途。

say:17:1222678013:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, there is no one more trustworthy than you.
say:17:1222678013:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, there is no one more trustworthy than you.
say:17:1222678013:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, there is no one more trustworthy than you.

choice_prompt:18:1222678013.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, there is no one more trustworthy than you.
choice_prompt:18:1222678013.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, there is no one more trustworthy than you.
choice_prompt:18:1222678013.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, there is no one more trustworthy than you.

say:19:1222678014:1.text: Hey, no worries! Chippy is super strong, Chippy will carry anything that doesn't fit in your pack!
say:19:1222678014:1.source_cn: 背包什么的，全都丢给满满！绝对不能让主人累着！
say:19:1222678014:1.male: Hey, no worries! Chippy is super strong, Chippy will carry anything that doesn't fit in your pack!
say:19:1222678014:1.female: Hey, no worries! Chippy is super strong, Chippy will carry anything that doesn't fit in your pack!

say:20:1222678018:1.text: When you're ready to set out, just say the word. Rustport will make sure you get a proper send-off.
say:20:1222678018:1.source_cn: 等你打算启程时，请务必告诉我——锈锚港会为你举行盛大的送行！
say:20:1222678018:1.male: When you're ready to set out, just say the word. Rustport will make sure you get a proper send-off.
say:20:1222678018:1.female: When you're ready to set out, just say the word. Rustport will make sure you get a proper send-off.

choice:18:0:1.text: This is a lot to carry.
choice:18:0:1.male: This is a lot to carry.
choice:18:0:1.female: This is a lot to carry.

say:22:1222678015:1.text: Be careful, it's packed with unimaginable power.
say:22:1222678015:1.source_cn: 要小心呀……这里面蕴含着深不可测的魔法。

say:23:1222678016:1.text: With your skills, I sincerely doubt anyone could take it from you.
say:23:1222678016:1.source_cn: 以你的能力，我相信没人能从你手中抢走它。
say:23:1222678016:1.male: With your skills, I sincerely doubt anyone could take it from you.
say:23:1222678016:1.female: With your skills, I sincerely doubt anyone could take it from you.

say:24:1222678017:1.text: And really, thank you again, for everything.
say:24:1222678017:1.source_cn: 多谢你，再次帮了我们一个大忙。
say:24:1222678017:1.male: And really, thank you again, for everything.
say:24:1222678017:1.female: And really, thank you again, for everything.

choice:18:2:3.text: This is a real hot potato...
choice:18:2:3.male: This is a real hot potato...
choice:18:2:3.female: This is a real hot potato...

say:25:1222678003:1.text: It wasn't an easy decision, especially with an entire empire backing her.
say:25:1222678003:1.source_cn: 这个决定不太容易，考虑到她背后有一整个帝国，实在是棘手。

cinematic_dialogue:2:1222628002:.text: This gift of yours, I graciously accept it.
cinematic_dialogue:2:1222628002:.source_cn: 你们送的礼物，我收下了

say:4:1222629001:0.text: Bonnie, you had an accomplice after all!

say:7:1222629003:0.text: Don't deny it. I'm not letting either of you escape.
say:7:1222629003:0.source_cn: 别想狡辩，你们一个也跑不了！

say:8:1222629004:0.text: Stop arguing with me, you idiot! What are you waiting for? Chase her!
say:8:1222629004:0.source_cn: 蠢货！你们还愣着干什么？还不快去追！

say:9:1222629005:1.text: <shk>She's gotten ahold of the Void Relic!</shk> She snatched it before you arrived!
say:9:1222629005:1.source_cn: <shk>班题斯圣器在她手上！！！</shk>在你们来...

say:10:1222629006:0.text: ... You're not in league with her?

say:11:1222629007:1.text: If you understand what I'm saying, stop standing around! Go after her!
say:11:1222629007:1.source_cn: 能听懂我的话就别傻站着！快去追上她！

say:12:1222629008:1.text: Tsk. I'll chase after her. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please stay and keep an eye on Bonnie!
say:12:1222629008:1.male: Tsk. I'll chase after her. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please stay and keep an eye on Bonnie!
say:12:1222629008:1.female: Tsk. I'll chase after her. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please stay and keep an eye on Bonnie!

cinematic_dialogue:15:1222628002:.text: This gift of yours, I graciously accept it.
cinematic_dialogue:15:1222628002:.source_cn: 你们送的礼物，我收下了

narration:17:12602214:0.text: By the time you catch up with Bonnie, she has already been subdued by Silvina. Silvina mockingly thanks you for your late arrival.
narration:17:12602214:0.source_cn: 你们追上波妮时，西尔维娜已经制服了波妮，见到你们姗姗来...

narration:18:12602214:0.text: By the time you catch up with Bonnie, she has already been subdued by Silvina. Silvina mockingly thanks you for your late arrival.
narration:18:12602214:0.source_cn: 你们追上波妮时，西尔维娜已经制服了波妮，见到你们姗姗来...

say:2:1222677001:1.text: Here's the boat. You can board, but you'll need to pay for a ticket.
say:2:1222677001:1.source_cn: 船就在这里，你可以上船。当然，你得付船票的钱。

say:3:1222677002:1.text: Payment? But you don't want money.

say:4:1222677003:1.source_cn: 说吧，我需要支付什么代价。

say:6:1222677005:1.text: I want you to deliver a message to the one you serve, the "Fallen King".
say:6:1222677005:1.source_cn: 帮我传个口信，带给你背后的主人——那位骸骨之王。

say:7:1222677006:1.text: Tell him that <style="highlight">the relic isn't in Rustport anymore</style>.

say:8:1222677007:1.text: Even if he sends more assassins, it won't matter. It'll only cost him.
say:8:1222677007:1.source_cn: 就算他派人来也毫无意义，只会得不偿失。

say:9:1222677008:1.text: Fine... I'll pass it on, but I can't guarantee what happens next.
say:9:1222677008:1.source_cn: 好……我会转达，但我不许诺结果。

say:10:1222677009:1.text: That's fine. If your king insists on coming, Rustport won't just sit and wait to be crushed.
say:10:1222677009:1.source_cn: 没关系，如果你的雇主不依不饶，锈锚港也不会坐以待毙。

say:11:1222677010:1.source_cn: 这一句，我也会一并转达。

say:13:1222677012:1.text: Why am I letting you go free, or why did I ask you to send a message?
say:13:1222677012:1.source_cn: 为什么放了你？还是，为什么让你带口信？

say:14:1222677013:1.text: Both. I could twist your words, stir up chaos.
say:14:1222677013:1.source_cn: 都有。我说不定会偷换口信的内容，煽风点火。

say:15:1222677014:0.text: Or I could return with the king's legions and bring Rustport to its knees.
say:15:1222677014:0.source_cn: 也有可能，我会带着骸骨之王的亡灵军团重返锈锚港。

say:16:1222677015:1.text: You must understand, the Dead Tide Fleet is a mere shadow when measured against the might of the king's army.
say:16:1222677015:1.source_cn: 区区死潮舰队，根本无法与那位君王座下的亡灵军团相提并论。

say:17:1222677016:1.text: Wow, this is the first time I've seen you talk this much. Hah!
say:17:1222677016:1.source_cn: 原来你能一次性说这么多话啊，哈哈哈哈！

say:18:1222677017:1.text: And here I thought you had an illness where saying more than a few words might kill you.
say:18:1222677017:1.source_cn: 还以为你得了一次多说几句话就会死掉的病。

say:19:1222677018:1.text: Though, I guess a Graveborn can't die twice, huh?
say:19:1222677018:1.source_cn: 不过，亡灵也不会再死一次了。

say:21:1222677020:1.text: And they don't have a sense of humor either.

say:22:1222677021:1.text: You still haven't answered my question.
say:22:1222677021:1.source_cn: 你还没有回答我的问题。

say:23:1222677022:1.text: ... If you're asking why, it's because once, I had a woman in my life. Someone very important to me.
say:23:1222677022:1.source_cn: ……问原因的话，因为我生命里也有一位重要的女性。

say:24:1222677023:1.text: I'm human, but she... became a Graveborn. Our time together was far from pleasant, but it's a time I'll never forget...
say:24:1222677023:1.source_cn: 我是人类，而她，成为了亡灵。我们的相处称不上愉快，但…...

say:25:1222677024:1.text: I don't know your reason for saving Nalianne, but it's clearly something you stand by, isn't it?
say:25:1222677024:1.source_cn: 我不知道你对女性手下留情的原因，至少，那是你行动的某种...

say:26:1222677025:1.text: Even when you were risking your life and the relic, you wouldn't break that principle.
say:26:1222677025:1.source_cn: 当你面临性命之危和圣器被夺的风险时，你也不愿意改变自己...

say:27:1222677026:1.text: She's just a regular person, and yet, you let yourself be captured to save her.
say:27:1222677026:1.source_cn: 那对你而言，只是个有着一面之缘的普通人，你却愿意为了救...

say:28:1222677027:1.text: A Graveborn who holds onto her principles like that... is someone worth trusting. That's how I see it.
say:28:1222677027:1.source_cn: 一个能够坚定原则的亡灵，她的承诺值得信任——我是这么想的。

say:29:1222677028:1.text: And hey, I'm a woman too. Does that mean I'm excluded from your principles?
say:29:1222677028:1.source_cn: 说到底，我也是个女性，难道我被排除在你的原则之外吗？

say:32:1222677031:1.text: Heh. Maybe your sense of humor isn't completely dead, after all.
say:32:1222677031:1.source_cn: 呵……我收回那句评价，你的幽默感不多，但起码不为零。

say:34:1222677033:1.text: Just like I'm trusting Rustport's future to you, I'll be trusting the Void Relic to another reliable person.
say:34:1222677033:1.source_cn: 就像我把锈锚港的命运托付给你一样，班题斯圣器我也会托付...

say:35:1222677034:1.text: Make sure to pass that on to your king, too.
say:35:1222677034:1.source_cn: 这个消息，也别忘了告诉那位君王。

say:36:1222677035:1.text: You're speaking of that magister, aren't you?

narration:44:12602503:0.text: After watching Silvina board the ship, Sonja turns her gaze to you.
narration:44:12602503:0.source_cn: 索尼娅目送西尔维娜上了船，转身把目光移向你。

cinematic_dialogue:1:1222618001:.text: Viperian didn't leave behind any research notes...
cinematic_dialogue:1:1222618001:.source_cn: 维珀里安竟然没留下研究说明……

cinematic_dialogue:1:1222667001:.text: It'll be at least half an hour.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1222667002:.text: We don't have that much time. Bring the boat over, now.
